##### 贡献法

[907. 子数组的最小值之和](https://leetcode.cn/problems/sum-of-subarray-minimums/)

```
int sumSubarrayMins(vector<int> &arr) {
    vector<int> left(arr.size());
    stack<int> lstack;
    for (int i = 0; i < arr.size(); i++) {
        while (!lstack.empty() && arr[lstack.top()] >= arr[i]) {
            lstack.pop();
        }
        left[i] = lstack.empty() ? -1 : lstack.top();
        lstack.push(i);
    }

    vector<int> right(arr.size());
    stack<int> rstack;
    for (int i = arr.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        while (!rstack.empty() && arr[rstack.top()] > arr[i]) {
            rstack.pop();
        }
        right[i] = rstack.empty() ? arr.size() : rstack.top();
        rstack.push(i);
    }

    long long result = 0;
    const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
    for (int i = 0; i < arr.size(); i++) {
        result += 1LL * arr[i] * (i - left[i]) * (right[i] - i);
    }
    return result % MOD;
}
```

##### 最小字典序

[402. 移掉 K 位数字](https://leetcode.cn/problems/remove-k-digits/)

```
string removeKdigits(string num, int k) {
    stack<int> stack;
    for (int i = 0; i < num.length(); i++) {
        while (k && !stack.empty() && num[stack.top()] > num[i]) {
            stack.pop();
            k--;
        }
        if (stack.empty() && num[i] == '0') {
            continue;
        }
        stack.push(i);
    }

    while (k && !stack.empty()) {
        stack.pop();
        k--;
    }

    string result = "";
    while (!stack.empty()) {
        result += num[stack.top()];
        stack.pop();
    }
    reverse(result.begin(), result.end());
    return result.empty() ? "0" : result;
}
```

```
    queue<int> queue;
    for (int i = deck.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        queue.push(deck[i]);
        if (i == 0) {
            break;
        }
        queue.push(queue.front());
        queue.pop();
    }
    vector<int> result(deck.size());
    for (int i = deck.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        result[i] = queue.front();
        queue.pop();
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
string predictPartyVictory(string senate) {
    queue<int> radiant;
    queue<int> dire;
    for (int i = 0; i < senate.length(); i++) {
        if (senate[i] == 'R') {
            radiant.push(i);
        } else {
            dire.push(i);
        }
    }

    while (!radiant.empty() && !dire.empty()) {
        if (radiant.front() < dire.front()) {
            radiant.push(radiant.front() + senate.size());
        } else {
            dire.push(dire.front() + senate.size());
        }
        radiant.pop();
        dire.pop();
    }
    return !radiant.empty() ? "Radiant" : "Dire";
}
```

[1670. 设计前中后队列](https://leetcode.cn/problems/design-front-middle-back-queue/)

```
class FrontMiddleBackQueue {
private:
    deque<int> left;
    deque<int> right;

private:
    void balance() {
        if (left.size() > right.size()) {
            right.push_front(left.back());
            left.pop_back();
        } else if (right.size() > left.size() + 1) {
            left.push_back(right.front());
            right.pop_front();
        }
    }

public:
    FrontMiddleBackQueue() {}

    void pushFront(int val) {
        left.push_front(val);
        balance();
    }

    void pushMiddle(int val) {
        if (left.size() >= right.size()) {
            right.push_front(val);
        } else {
            left.push_back(val);
        }
    }

    void pushBack(int val) {
        right.push_back(val);
        balance();
    }

    int popFront() {
        if (right.empty()) {
            return -1;
        }
        int val;
        if (left.empty()) {
            val = right.front();
            right.pop_front();
        } else {
            val = left.front();
            left.pop_front();
        }
        balance();
        return val;
    }

    int popMiddle() {
        if (right.empty()) {
            return -1;
        }
        int val;
        if (left.size() == right.size()) {
            val = left.back();
            left.pop_back();
        } else {
            val = right.front();
            right.pop_front();
        }
        return val;
    }

    int popBack() {
        if (right.empty()) {
            return -1;
        }
        int val = right.back();
        right.pop_back();
        balance();
        return val;
    }
};
```

```
class MyQueue {
private:

    stack<int> stack2;

public:
    MyQueue() {

    }

        stack1.push(x);
    }

    int pop() {
        while (!stack1.empty()) {
            stack2.push(stack1.top());
            stack1.pop();
        }
        int result = stack2.top();
        stack2.pop();
        while (!stack2.empty()) {
            stack1.push(stack2.top());
            stack2.pop();

        return result;

    int peek() {

            stack2.push(stack1.top());
            stack1.pop();

        int result = stack2.top();
        while (!stack2.empty()) {
            stack1.push(stack2.top());
            stack2.pop();
        }
        return result;
    }

    bool empty() {
        return stack1.empty();
    }
};
```

[622. 设计循环队列](https://leetcode.cn/problems/design-circular-queue/)

```
class MyCircularQueue {
private:
    int front;
    int rear;
    int capacity;
    vector<int> queue;

public:
    MyCircularQueue(int k) {
        front = 0;
        rear = 0;
        capacity = k + 1;
        queue = vector<int>(capacity);
    }

    bool enQueue(int value) {
        if (isFull()) {
            return false;
        }
        queue[rear] = value;
        rear = (rear + 1) % capacity;
        return true;
    }

    bool deQueue() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        int value = queue[front];
        front = (front + 1) % capacity;
        return true;
    }

    int Front() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            return -1;
        }
        return queue[front];
    }

    int Rear() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            return -1;
        }
        return queue[(rear - 1 + capacity) % capacity];
    }

    bool isEmpty() {
        return front == rear;
    }

    bool isFull() {
        return (rear + 1) % capacity == front;
    }
};
```

[641. 设计循环双端队列](https://leetcode.cn/problems/design-circular-deque/)

```
class MyCircularDeque {
private:
    int front;
    int rear;
    int capacity;
    deque<int> queue;

public:
    MyCircularDeque(int k) {
        front = 0;
        rear = 0;
        capacity = k + 1;
        queue = deque<int>(capacity);
    }

    bool insertFront(int value) {
        if (isFull()) {
            return false;
        }
        front = (front - 1 + capacity) % capacity;
        queue[front] = value;
        return true;
    }

    bool insertLast(int value) {
        if (isFull()) {
            return false;
        }
        queue[rear] = value;
        rear = (rear + 1) % capacity;
        return true;
    }

    bool deleteFront() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        front = (front + 1) % capacity;
        return true;
    }

    bool deleteLast() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            return false;
        }
        rear = (rear - 1 + capacity) % capacity;
        return true;
    }

    int getFront() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            return -1;
        }
        return queue[front];
    }

    int getRear() {
        if (isEmpty()) {
            return -1;
        }
        return queue[(rear - 1 + capacity) % capacity];
    }

    bool isEmpty() {
        return front == rear;
    }

    bool isFull() {
        return (rear + 1) % capacity == front;
    }
};
```

[239. 滑动窗口最大值](https://leetcode.cn/problems/sliding-window-maximum/)

```
vector<int> maxSlidingWindow(vector<int> &nums, int k) {
    vector<int> result(nums.size() - k + 1);
    deque<int> deque;
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        while (!deque.empty() && nums[deque.back()] <= nums[i]) {
            deque.pop_back();
        }
        deque.push_back(i);

        int left = i - k + 1;
        if (deque.front() < left) {
            deque.pop_front();
        }

        if (left >= 0) {
            result[left] = nums[deque.front()];
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
class Checkout {
private:
    queue<int> queue;
    deque<int> deque;

public:
    Checkout() {}

    int get_max() {
        return deque.empty() ? -1 : deque.front();
    }

    void add(int value) {
        queue.push(value);
        while (!deque.empty() && deque.back() < value) {
            deque.pop_back();
        }
        deque.push_back(value);
    }

    int remove() {
        if (queue.empty()) {
            return -1;
        }

        queue.pop();
        if (value == deque.front()) {

    }
};
```

[1438. 绝对差不超过限制的最长连续子数组](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-continuous-subarray-with-absolute-diff-less-than-or-equal-to-limit/)

```
int longestSubarray(vector<int> &nums, int limit) {
    int result = 0;
    deque<int> decrement;
    deque<int> increment;
    int left = 0;
    int right = 0;
    while (right < nums.size()) {
        while (!decrement.empty() && nums[decrement.back()] < nums[right]) {
            decrement.pop_back();
        }
        decrement.push_back(right);
        while (!increment.empty() && nums[increment.back()] > nums[right]) {
            increment.pop_back();
        }
        increment.push_back(right);
        while (!increment.empty() && !decrement.empty() && nums[decrement.front()] - nums[increment.front()] > limit) {
            if (nums[left] == nums[decrement.front()]) {
                decrement.pop_front();
            }
            if (nums[left] == nums[increment.front()]) {
                increment.pop_front();
            }
            left++;
        }
        result = max(result, right - left + 1);
        right++;
    }
    return result;
}
```

[2762. 不间断子数组](https://leetcode.cn/problems/continuous-subarrays/)

```
long long continuousSubarrays(vector<int> &nums) {
    long long result = 0;
    deque<int> decrement;
    deque<int> increment;
    int left = 0;
    int right = 0;
    while (right < nums.size()) {
        while (!decrement.empty() && nums[decrement.back()] < nums[right]) {
            decrement.pop_back();
        }
        decrement.push_back(right);
        while (!increment.empty() && nums[increment.back()] > nums[right]) {
            increment.pop_back();
        }
        increment.push_back(right);
        while (!increment.empty() && !decrement.empty() && nums[decrement.front()] - nums[increment.front()] > 2) {
            if (left + 1 > decrement.front()) {
                decrement.pop_front();
            }
            if (left + 1 > increment.front()) {
                increment.pop_front();
            }
            left++;
        }
        result += right - left + 1;
        right++;
    }
    return result;
}
```

[3264. K 次乘运算后的最终数组 I](https://leetcode.cn/problems/final-array-state-after-k-multiplication-operations-i/)

```
vector<int> getFinalState(vector<int> &nums, int k, int multiplier) {
    const auto comp = [](const pair<int, int> &a, const pair<int, int> &b) {
        if (a.first > b.first) {
            return true;
        } else if (a.first < b.first) {
            return false;
        } else {
            return a.second > b.second;
        }
    };
    priority_queue<pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int>>, decltype(comp)> pq;
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        pq.push({nums[i], i});
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        int value = pq.top().first;
        int index = pq.top().second;
        pq.pop();
        pq.push({value * multiplier, index});
    }
    vector<int> result(nums.size());
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        result[pq.top().second] = pq.top().first;
        pq.pop();
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
long long minNumberOfSeconds(int mountainHeight, vector<int> &workerTimes) {
    priority_queue<tuple<long long, int, int>, vector<tuple<long long, int, int>>, greater<tuple<long long, int, int>>> pq;
    for (int i = 0; i < workerTimes.size(); i++) {
        pq.push({static_cast<long long>(workerTimes[i]), i, 1});
    }

    long long result = 0LL;
    while (mountainHeight--) {
        auto [time, index, count] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        result = max(result, time);
        pq.push({time + static_cast<long long>(workerTimes[index]) * (count + 1), index, count + 1});
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
int smallestChair(vector<vector<int>> &times, int targetFriend) {
    vector<pair<int, int>> arrival;
    vector<pair<int, int>> leaving;
    for (int i = 0; i < times.size(); i++) {
        arrival.push_back({times[i][0], i});
        leaving.push_back({times[i][1], i});
    }
    sort(arrival.begin(), arrival.end());
    sort(leaving.begin(), leaving.end());
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<int>> available;
    for (int i = 0; i < times.size(); i++) {
        available.push(i);
    }
    unordered_map<int, int> seats;
    int i = 0;
    for (const auto &&[time, index]: arrival) {
        while (i < times.size() && leaving[i].first <= time) {
            available.push(seats[leaving[i].second]);
            i++;
        }
        int seat = available.top();
        seats[index] = seat;
        available.pop();
        if (index == targetFriend) {
            return seat;
        }
    }
    return -1;
}
```

[1801. 积压订单中的订单总数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/number-of-orders-in-the-backlog/)

```
int getNumberOfBacklogOrders(vector<vector<int>> &orders) {
    priority_queue<pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int>>, less<>> buy;
    priority_queue<pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int>>, greater<>> sell;
    for (auto &order: orders) {
        int price = order[0];
        int amount = order[1];
        int type = order[2];
        if (type == 0) {
            while (amount > 0 && !sell.empty() && sell.top().first <= price) {
                if (sell.top().second <= amount) {
                    amount -= sell.top().second;
                    sell.pop();
                } else {
                    auto o = sell.top();
                    sell.pop();
                    o.second -= amount;
                    sell.push(o);
                    amount = 0;
                }
            }
            if (amount > 0) {
                buy.push({price, amount});
            }
        } else {
            while (amount > 0 && !buy.empty() && buy.top().first >= price) {
                if (buy.top().second <= amount) {
                    amount -= buy.top().second;
                    buy.pop();
                } else {
                    auto o = buy.top();
                    buy.pop();
                    o.second -= amount;
                    buy.push(o);
                    amount = 0;
                }
            }
            if (amount) {
                sell.push({price, amount});
            }
        }
    }
    const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
    int result = 0;
    while (!buy.empty()) {
        result = (result + buy.top().second) % MOD;
        buy.pop();
    }
    while (!sell.empty()) {
        result = (result + sell.top().second) % MOD;
        sell.pop();
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<long long> findMaxSum(vector<int> &nums1, vector<int> &nums2, int k) {
    vector<vector<int>> map(nums1.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < nums1.size(); i++) {
        map[i] = {nums1[i], nums2[i], i};
    }
    sort(map.begin(), map.end());

    vector<long long> result(nums1.size());
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<>> pq;
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0, j = 0; i < nums1.size(); i++) {
        while (j < nums1.size() && map[j][0] < map[i][0]) {
            pq.push(map[j][1]);
            sum += map[j][1];
            j++;
        }
        while (pq.size() > k) {
            sum -= pq.top();
            pq.pop();
        }
        result[map[i][2]] = sum;
    }
    return result;
}
```

[2462. 雇佣 K 位工人的总代价](https://leetcode.cn/problems/total-cost-to-hire-k-workers/)

```
long long totalCost(vector<int> &costs, int k, int candidates) {
    if (costs.size() < 2 * candidates + k) {
        sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
        return accumulate(costs.begin(), costs.begin() + k, 0LL);
    }

    int left = 0;
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<>> l;
    for (int i = 0; i < candidates; i++) {
        l.push(costs[left]);
        left++;
    }

    int right = costs.size() - 1;
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<>> r;
    for (int i = 0; i < candidates; i++) {
        r.push(costs[right]);
        right--;
    }

    long long result = 0;
    while (k--) {
        if (!l.empty() && !r.empty()) {
            if (l.top() <= r.top()) {
                result += l.top();
                l.pop();
                l.push(costs[left]);
                left++;
            } else {
                result += r.top();
                r.pop();
                r.push(costs[right]);
                right--;
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[1834. 单线程 CPU](https://leetcode.cn/problems/single-threaded-cpu/)

```
vector<int> getOrder(vector<vector<int>> &tasks) {
    vector<vector<int>> t(tasks.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < tasks.size(); i++) {
        t[i] = {tasks[i][0], tasks[i][1], i};
    }
    sort(t.begin(), t.end());

    priority_queue<pair<int, int>, vector<pair<int, int>>, greater<>> pq;
    int time = 0;
    int index = 0;   // t 数组指针
    vector<int> result;
    while (index < tasks.size() || !pq.empty()) {
        if (pq.empty() && time < t[index][0]) {
            time = t[index][0];
        }

        while (index < tasks.size() && t[index][0] <= time) {
            pq.push({t[index][1], t[index][2]});
            index++;
        }

        time += pq.top().first;
        result.push_back(pq.top().second);
        pq.pop();
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
        int f = 1;
        if (freq == "minute") {
            f = f * 60;
        } else if (freq == "hour") {
            f = f * 60 * 60;
        } else {
            f = f * 60 * 60 * 24;
        }
        vector<int> result((endTime - startTime) / f + 1);
        for (const auto &time: map[tweetName]) {
            if (time >= startTime && time <= endTime) {
                result[(time - startTime) / f]++;
            }
        }
        return result;
    }
```

```
int nthUglyNumber(int n) {
    vector<int> factors = {2, 3, 5};
    set<long long> set;
    priority_queue<long long, vector<long long>, greater<>> pq;
    set.insert(1);
    pq.push(1);
    long long num = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
        num = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        for (const auto &factor: factors) {
            long long next = factor * num;
            if (!set.contains(next)) {
                set.insert(next);
                pq.push(next);
            }
        }
    }
    return pq.top();
}
```

[23. 合并 K 个升序链表](https://leetcode.cn/problems/merge-k-sorted-lists/)

```
ListNode *mergeKLists(vector<ListNode *> &lists) {
    const auto greater = [](const ListNode *a, const ListNode *b) { return a->val > b->val; };
    priority_queue<ListNode *, vector<ListNode *>, decltype(greater)> pq;
    for (const auto &list: lists) {
        if (list) {
            ListNode *current = list;
            ListNode *next = list->next;
            while (next) {
                pq.push(current);
                current = next;
                next = next->next;
            }
            pq.push(current);
        }
    }
    ListNode head;
    ListNode *tail = &head;
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        tail->next = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        tail = tail->next;
    }
    tail->next = nullptr;
    return head.next;
}
```

```
vector<vector<int>> kSmallestPairs(vector<int> &nums1, vector<int> &nums2, int k) {
    priority_queue<vector<int>, vector<vector<int>>, greater<>> pq;
    for (int i = 0; i < min(static_cast<int>(nums1.size()), k); i++) {
        pq.push({nums1[i] + nums2[0], i, 0});
    }

    vector<vector<int>> result;
    while (k--) {
        int i = pq.top()[1];
        int j = pq.top()[2];
        pq.pop();
        result.push_back({nums1[i], nums2[j]});
        if (j + 1 < nums2.size()) {
            pq.push({nums1[i] + nums2[j + 1], i, j + 1});
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
string strWithout3a3b(int a, int b) {
    if (b == 0) return string(a, 'a');
    if (a == 0) return string(b, 'b');
    if (a == b) return "ab" + strWithout3a3b(a - 1, b - 1);
    return a > b ? "aab" + strWithout3a3b(a - 2, b - 1) : "bba" + strWithout3a3b(a - 1, b - 2);
}
```

```
string reorganizeString(string s) {
    int maximum = 0;
    vector<int> counts(26);
    for (const auto &c: s) {
        counts[c - 'a']++;
        maximum = max(maximum, counts[c - 'a']);
    }
    if (maximum > (s.size() + 1) / 2) {
        return "";
    }


    priority_queue<pair<int, char>> pq;
    for (int i = 0; i < counts.size(); i++) {
        if (counts[i] > 0) {
            pq.push({counts[i], i + 'a'});
        }
    }

    string result;
    while (pq.size() > 1) {
        auto [count1, letter1] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();

        auto [count2, letter2] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();

        result += letter1;
        count1--;
        if (count1 > 0) {
            pq.push({count1, letter1});
        }
        
        result += letter2;
        count2--;
        if (count2 > 0) {
            pq.push({count2, letter2});
        }
    }
    if (!pq.empty()) {
        result += pq.top().second;
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<int> rearrangeBarcodes(vector<int> &barcodes) {
    unordered_map<int, int> counts;
    for (const auto &barcode: barcodes) {
        counts[barcode]++;
    }

    priority_queue<pair<int, int>> pq;
    for (const auto &[barcode, count]: counts) {
        pq.push({count, barcode});
    }

    vector<int> result;
    while (pq.size() > 1) {
        auto [count1, barcode1] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        auto [count2, barcode2] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();

        result.push_back(barcode1);
        count1--;
        if (count1 > 0) {
            pq.push({count1, barcode1});
        }

        result.push_back(barcode2);
        count2--;
        if (count2 > 0) {
            pq.push({count2, barcode2});
        }
    }
    if (!pq.empty()) {
        result.push_back(pq.top().second);
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
int magicTower(vector<int> &nums) {
    if (accumulate(nums.begin(), nums.end(), 0LL) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    long long sum = 1;
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<>> pq;
    int result = 0;
    for (const auto &num: nums) {
        if (num < 0) {
            pq.push(num);
        }
        sum += num;
        if (sum < 1) {
            sum -= pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            result++;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[3607. 电网维护](https://leetcode.cn/problems/power-grid-maintenance/)

```
vector<int> processQueries(int c, vector<vector<int>> &connections, vector<vector<int>> &queries) {
    vector<vector<int>> graph(c);
    for (const auto &connection: connections) {
        graph[connection[0] - 1].push_back(connection[1] - 1);
        graph[connection[1] - 1].push_back(connection[0] - 1);
    }

    vector<int> belong(c, -1);
    vector<priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<>>> heaps;
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<>> pq;

    const function<void(int)> dfs = [&](int node) {
        belong[node] = heaps.size();
        pq.push(node);
        for (const auto &neighbor: graph[node]) {
            if (belong[neighbor] < 0) {
                dfs(neighbor);
            }
        }
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < c; i++) {
        if (belong[i] < 0) {
            dfs(i);
            heaps.emplace_back(move(pq));
        }
    }

    vector<int> result;
    vector<int8_t> offline(c);
    for (const auto &query: queries) {
        vector<bool> visited(c);
        if (query[0] == 1) {
            if (!offline[query[1] - 1]) {
                result.push_back(query[1]);
            } else {
                auto &heap = heaps[belong[query[1] - 1]];
                while (!heap.empty() && offline[heap.top()]) {
                    heap.pop();
                }
                result.push_back(heap.empty() ? -1 : heap.top() + 1);
            }
        } else {
            offline[query[1] - 1] = true;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
class FoodRatings {
private:
    unordered_map<string, pair<int, string>> ftorc;
    unordered_map<string, priority_queue<pair<int, string>, vector<pair<int, string>>, greater<>>> ctorf;

public:
    FoodRatings(vector<string> &foods, vector<string> &cuisines, vector<int> &ratings) {
        for (int i = 0; i < foods.size(); i++) {
            string food = foods[i];
            string cuisine = cuisines[i];
            int rating = ratings[i];
            ftorc[food] = {rating, cuisine};
            ctorf[cuisine].push({-rating, food});
        }
    }

    void changeRating(string food, int newRating) {
        auto &[rating, cuisine] = ftorc[food];
        ctorf[cuisine].push({-newRating, food});
        rating = newRating;
    }

    string highestRated(string cuisine) {
        auto &rf = ctorf[cuisine];
        while (!rf.empty() && ftorc[rf.top().second].first != -rf.top().first) {
            rf.pop();
        }
        return rf.empty() ? "" : rf.top().second;
    }
};
```

```
class Trie {
private:
    bool end;
    unordered_map<char, Trie *> children;

public:
    Trie() : end(false) {}

    void insert(string word) {
        Trie *node = this;
        for (const auto &c: word) {
            if (!node->children.contains(c)) {
                node->children[c] = new Trie();
            }
            node = node->children[c];
        }
        node->end = true;
    }

    bool search(string word) {
        Trie *node = this;
        for (const auto &c: word) {
            if (!node->children.contains(c)) {
                return false;
            }
            node = node->children[c];
        }
        return node->end;
    }

    bool startsWith(string prefix) {
        Trie *node = this;
        for (const auto &c: prefix) {
            if (!node->children.contains(c)) {
                return false;
            }
            node = node->children[c];
        }
        return true;
    }
};
```

```
vector<string> partitionString(string s) {
    struct Trie {
        unordered_map<char, Trie *> children;
    };
    Trie *root = new Trie();
    Trie *curr = root;
    vector<string> result;
    int i = 0;
    for (int j = 0; j < s.size(); j++) {
        if (!curr->children[s[j]]) {
            curr->children[s[j]] = new Trie();
            result.push_back(s.substr(i, j - i + 1));
            i = j + 1;
            curr = root;
        } else {
            curr = curr->children[s[j]];
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[648. 单词替换](https://leetcode.cn/problems/replace-words/)

```
string replaceWords(vector<string> &dictionary, string sentence) {
    const auto &parse = [](const string &sentence) {
        vector<string> words;
        istringstream iss(sentence);
        string word;
        while (iss >> word) {
            words.push_back(word);
        }
        return words;
    };

    class Trie {
    public:
        vector<Trie *> children;
        bool end;
    public:
        Trie() : children(vector<Trie *>(26)), end(false) {

        }

        void insert(const string &s) {
            Trie *node = this;
            for (const auto &c: s) {
                if (!node->children[c - 'a']) {
                    node->children[c - 'a'] = new Trie();
                }
                node = node->children[c - 'a'];
            }
            node->end = true;
        }
    };

    const auto &search = [](Trie *root, const string &s) {
        string result;
        Trie *node = root;
        for (const auto &c: s) {
            if (node->end) {
                return result;
            } else {
                if (node->children[c - 'a']) {
                    result += c;
                    node = node->children[c - 'a'];
                } else {
                    return s;
                }
            }
        }
        return result;
    };

    Trie root;
    vector<string> words = parse(sentence);
    for (const auto &s: dictionary) {
        root.insert(s);
    }
    string result;
    for (int i = 0; i < words.size(); i++) {
        words[i] = search(&root, words[i]);
        result += words[i];
        if (i != words.size() - 1) {
            result += " ";
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[720. 词典中最长的单词](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-word-in-dictionary/)

```
string longestWord(vector<string> &words) {
    class Trie {
    private:
        vector<Trie *> children;
        bool end;
    public:
        Trie() : children(vector<Trie *>(26)), end(false) {

        }

        void insert(const string &s) {
            Trie *node = this;
            for (const auto &c: s) {
                if (!node->children[c - 'a']) {
                    node->children[c - 'a'] = new Trie();
                }
                node = node->children[c - 'a'];
            }
            node->end = true;
        }

        bool search(const string &s) {
            Trie *node = this;
            for (const auto &c: s) {
                if (!node->children[c - 'a'] || !node->children[c - 'a']->end) {
                    return false;
                }
                node = node->children[c - 'a'];
            }
            return node && node->end;
        }
    };

    Trie *root = new Trie();
    for (const auto &word: words) {
        root->insert(word);
    }
    string result;
    for (const auto &word: words) {
        if (root->search(word)) {
            if (word.size() > result.size()) {
                result = word;
            } else if (word.size() == result.size()) {
                result = min(result, word);
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<int> sumPrefixScores(vector<string> &words) {
    struct Trie {
        Trie *children[26];
        int score;
    };

    Trie *root = new Trie();
    for (const auto &word: words) {
        Trie *curr = root;
        for (const auto &c: word) {
            if (!curr->children[c - 'a']) {
                curr->children[c - 'a'] = new Trie();
            }
            curr = curr->children[c - 'a'];
            curr->score++;
        }
    }

    vector<int> result(words.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < words.size(); i++) {
        Trie *curr = root;
        for (const auto &c: words[i]) {
            curr = curr->children[c - 'a'];
            result[i] += curr->score;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[677. 键值映射](https://leetcode.cn/problems/map-sum-pairs/)

```
class MapSum {
private:
    struct Trie {
        int val;
        vector<Trie *> children;

        Trie() : val(0), children(vector<Trie *>(26)) {

        }
    };

    Trie *root;
    unordered_map<string, int> count;

public:
    MapSum() : root(new Trie()) {

    }

    void insert(string key, int val) {
        int delta = val;
        if (count.contains(key)) {
            delta -= count[key];
        }
        count[key] = val;
        Trie *node = root;
        for (const auto &c: key) {
            if (!node->children[c - 'a']) {
                node->children[c - 'a'] = new Trie();
            }
            node = node->children[c - 'a'];
            node->val += delta;
        }
    }

    int sum(string prefix) {
        Trie *node = root;
        for (const auto &c: prefix) {
            if (!node->children[c - 'a']) {
                return 0;
            }
            node = node->children[c - 'a'];
        }
        return node->val;
    }
};
```

[1268. 搜索推荐系统](https://leetcode.cn/problems/search-suggestions-system/)

```
vector<vector<string>> suggestedProducts(vector<string> &products, string searchWord) {
    struct Trie {
        unordered_map<char, Trie *> children;
        priority_queue<string> words;
    };

    const auto add = [](Trie *root, const string &word) {
        Trie *curr = root;
        for (const auto &c: word) {
            if (!curr->children.contains(c)) {
                curr->children[c] = new Trie();
            }
            curr = curr->children[c];
            curr->words.push(word);
            if (curr->words.size() > 3) {
                curr->words.pop();
            }
        }
    };

    Trie *root = new Trie();
    for (const string &product: products) {
        add(root, product);
    }

    vector<vector<string>> result;
    Trie *curr = root;
    bool flag = false;
    for (const auto &c: searchWord) {
        if (flag || !curr->children.contains(c)) {
            result.push_back({});
            flag = true;
        } else {
            curr = curr->children[c];
            vector<string> strings;
            while (!curr->words.empty()) {
                strings.push_back(curr->words.top());
                curr->words.pop();
            }
            reverse(strings.begin(), strings.end());
            result.push_back(strings);
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<string> removeSubfolders(vector<string> &folder) {
    struct Trie {
        unordered_map<string, Trie *> children;
        int ref;

        Trie() : ref(-1) {}
    };

    Trie *root = new Trie();
    for (int i = 0; i < folder.size(); i++) {
        vector<string> nodes;
        size_t begin = 0;
        size_t end = folder[i].find('/', begin);
        while (end != std::string::npos) {
            string s = folder[i].substr(begin, end - begin);
            nodes.push_back(s);
            begin = end + 1;
            end = folder[i].find('/', begin);
        }
        nodes.push_back(folder[i].substr(begin));
        Trie *curr = root;
        for (auto &node: nodes) {
            if (!curr->children.contains(node)) {
                curr->children[node] = new Trie();

            }
            curr = curr->children[node];
        }
        curr->ref = i;
    }
    vector<string> result;
    function<void(Trie *)> dfs = [&](Trie *root) {
        if (root->ref != -1) {
            result.push_back(folder[root->ref]);
            return;
        }
        for (auto &&[_, child]: root->children) {
            dfs(child);
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    return result;
}
```

[820. 单词的压缩编码](https://leetcode.cn/problems/short-encoding-of-words/)

```
int minimumLengthEncoding(vector<string> &words) {
    struct Trie {
        unordered_map<char, Trie *> children;
        int depth;
    };

    Trie *root = new Trie();
    for (const auto &word: words) {
        string r = word;
        reverse(r.begin(), r.end());
        Trie *curr = root;
        for (const auto &c: r) {
            if (!curr->children.contains(c)) {
                curr->children[c] = new Trie();
                curr->children[c]->depth = curr->depth + 1;
            }
            curr = curr->children[c];
        }
    }
    int result = 0;
    function<void(Trie *, int &)> dfs = [&](Trie *root, int &result) {
        if (!root->children.empty()) {
            for (auto &&[_, child]: root->children) {
                dfs(child, result);
            }
        } else {
            result += root->depth + 1;
        }
    };
    dfs(root, result);
    return result;
}
```

[684. 冗余连接](https://leetcode.cn/problems/redundant-connection/)

```
vector<int> findRedundantConnection(vector<vector<int>> &edges) {
    vector<int> parent(edges.size() + 1);
    iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);
    const function<int(int)> find = [&](int x) {
        return parent[x] == x ? x : parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
    };

    const auto unite = [&](int x, int y) {
        parent[find(x)] = find(y);
    };

    const auto connected = [&](int x, int y) {
        return find(x) == find(y);
    };

    for (const auto &edge: edges) {
        if (connected(edge[0], edge[1])) {
            return edge;
        } else {
            unite(edge[0], edge[1]);
        }
    }
    return {};
}
```

[3493. 属性图](https://leetcode.cn/problems/properties-graph/)

```
int numberOfComponents(vector<vector<int>> &properties, int k) {
    int count = properties.size();
    vector<int> parent(properties.size());
    iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);

    const function<int(int)> find = [&](int x) {
        return parent[x] == x ? x : parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
    };

    const auto unite = [&](int x, int y) {
        int xroot = find(x);
        int yroot = find(y);
        if (xroot != yroot) {
            parent[xroot] = yroot;
            count--;
        }
    };

    const auto intersect = [](vector<int> a, vector<int> b) {
        sort(a.begin(), a.end());
        sort(b.begin(), b.end());
        vector<int> result;
        set_intersection(a.begin(), a.end(), b.begin(), b.end(), back_inserter(result));
        return set<int>(result.begin(), result.end()).size();
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < properties.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = i + 1; j < properties.size(); j++) {
            if (intersect(properties[i], properties[j]) >= k) {
                unite(i, j);
            }
        }
    }

    return count;
}
```

```
bool equationsPossible(vector<string> &equations) {
    vector<int> parent(26);
    iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);

    const function<int(int)> find = [&](int x) {
        return parent[x] == x ? x : parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
    };

    const auto unite = [&](int x, int y) {
        parent[find(x)] = find(y);
    };

    const auto connected = [&](int x, int y) {
        return find(x) == find(y);
    };

    for (const auto &equation: equations) {
        if (equation[1] == '=') {
            unite(equation[0] - 'a', equation[3] - 'a');
        }
    }

    for (const auto &equation: equations) {
        if (equation[1] == '!') {
            if (connected(equation[0] - 'a', equation[3] - 'a')) {
                return false;
            }
        }
    }

    return true;
}
```

[721. 账户合并](https://leetcode.cn/problems/accounts-merge/)

```
vector<vector<string>> accountsMerge(vector<vector<string>> &accounts) {
    vector<int> parent(accounts.size());
    iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);

    const function<int(int)> find = [&](int x) {
        return parent[x] == x ? x : parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
    };

    const auto unite = [&](int x, int y) {
        parent[find(x)] = find(y);
    };

    unordered_map<string, int> etoi;
    for (int i = 0; i < accounts.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < accounts[i].size(); j++) {
            const string &email = accounts[i][j];
            if (etoi.contains(email)) {
                unite(i, etoi[email]);
            } else {
                etoi[email] = i;
            }
        }
    }

    unordered_map<int, set<string>> itoe;
    for (auto &&[email, index]: etoi) {
        itoe[find(index)].insert(email);
    }

    vector<vector<string>> result;
    for (auto &&[index, emails]: itoe) {
        vector<string> account;
        account.push_back(accounts[index][0]);
        account.insert(account.end(), emails.begin(), emails.end());
        result.push_back(account);
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<bool> pathExistenceQueries(int n, vector<int> &nums, int maxDiff, vector<vector<int>> &queries) {
    vector<int> parent(n);
    iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);

    const function<int(int)> find = [&](int x) {
        return parent[x] == x ? x : parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
    };

    const auto unite = [&](int x, int y) {
        parent[find(x)] = find(y);
    };

    const auto connected = [&](int x, int y) {
        return find(x) == find(y);
    };

    for (int i = 1; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        if (nums[i] - nums[i - 1] <= maxDiff) {
            unite(i, i - 1);
        }
    }

    vector<bool> result(queries.size());
    for (int i = 0; i < queries.size(); i++) {
        result[i] = connected(queries[i][0], queries[i][1]);
    }
    return result;
}
```

[2709. 最大公约数遍历](https://leetcode.cn/problems/greatest-common-divisor-traversal/)

```
bool canTraverseAllPairs(vector<int> &nums) {
    if (nums.size() == 1) {
        return true;
    }

    int maximum = 0;
    for (const auto &num: nums) {
        if (num == 1) {
            return false;
        }
        maximum = max(maximum, num);
    }

    vector<int> parent(maximum + 1);
    iota(parent.begin(), parent.end(), 0);

    const function<int(int)> find = [&](int x) {
        return parent[x] == x ? x : parent[x] = find(parent[x]);
    };

    const auto unite = [&](int x, int y) {
        parent[find(x)] = find(y);
    };

    for (const auto &num: nums) {
        for (int i = 2; i * i <= num; i++) {
            if (num % i == 0) {
                unite(num, i);
                unite(num, num / i);
            }
        }
    }

    int root = 0;
    for (const auto &num: nums) {
        int curr = find(num);
        if (root == 0) {
            root = curr;
        } else if (curr != root) {
            return false;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
```

[307. 区域和检索 - 数组可修改](https://leetcode.cn/problems/range-sum-query-mutable/)

```
class NumArray {
private:
    vector<int> nums;
    vector<int> tree;

private:
    int prefix(int i) {
        int sum = 0;
        while (i > 0) {
            sum += tree[i];
            i &= i - 1;
        }
        return sum;
    }

public:
    NumArray(vector<int> &nums) : nums(nums.size()), tree(nums.size() + 1) {
        for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
            update(i, nums[i]);
        }
    }

    void update(int index, int val) {
        int delta = val - nums[index];
        nums[index] = val;
        for (int i = index + 1; i < tree.size(); i += i & -i) {
            tree[i] += delta;
        }
    }

    int sumRange(int left, int right) {
        return prefix(right + 1) - prefix(left);
    }
};
```

[LCR 170. 交易逆序对的总数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/shu-zu-zhong-de-ni-xu-dui-lcof/)

```
int reversePairs(vector<int> &record) {
    int count = 0;

    const auto sort = [&](vector<int> &nums, int left, int mid, int right) {
        vector<int> result(right - left + 1);
        int i = left;
        int j = mid + 1;
        int k = 0;
        while (i <= mid && j <= right) {
            if (nums[i] <= nums[j]) {
                result[k++] = nums[i++];
            } else {
                count += (mid - i + 1);
                result[k++] = nums[j++];
            }
        }
        while (i <= mid) {
            result[k++] = nums[i++];
        }
        while (j <= right) {
            result[k++] = nums[j++];
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            nums[left + i] = result[i];
        }
    };

    const function<void(vector<int> &, int, int)> merge = [&](vector<int> &nums, int left, int right) {
        if (left < right) {
            int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
            merge(nums, left, mid);
            merge(nums, mid + 1, right);
            sort(nums, left, mid, right);
        }
    };

    merge(record, 0, record.size() - 1);
    return count;
}
```

[2058. 找出临界点之间的最小和最大距离](https://leetcode.cn/problems/find-the-minimum-and-maximum-number-of-nodes-between-critical-points/)

```
vector<int> nodesBetweenCriticalPoints(ListNode *head) {
    ListNode *prev = head;
    ListNode *curr = prev->next;
    ListNode *next = curr->next;
    int index = 1;
    vector<int> indices;
    while (next) {
        if (prev->val < curr->val && curr->val > next->val || prev->val > curr->val && curr->val < next->val) {
            indices.push_back(index);
        }
        prev = curr;
        curr = prev->next;
        next = curr->next;
        index++;
    }
    if (indices.size() < 2) {
        return {-1, -1};
    }
    
    int minimum = INT_MAX;
    for (int i = 1; i < indices.size(); i++) {
        minimum = min(minimum, indices[i] - indices[i - 1]);
    }
    return {minimum, indices.back() - indices.front()};
}
```

[725. 分隔链表](https://leetcode.cn/problems/split-linked-list-in-parts/)

```
vector<ListNode *> splitListToParts(ListNode *head, int k) {
    const auto &size = [](ListNode *head) {
        int size = 0;
        while (head) {
            size++;
            head = head->next;
        }
        return size;
    };
    int s = size(head);
    int quotients = s / k;
    int remainder = s % k;
    vector<int> sizes(k, quotients);
    for (int i = 0; remainder; i++) {
        sizes[i]++;
        remainder--;
    }
    vector<ListNode *> result(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        ListNode dummy;
        ListNode *tail = &dummy;
        while (head && sizes[i]--) {
            tail->next = head;
            tail = tail->next;
            head = head->next;
        }
        tail->next = nullptr;
        result[i] = dummy.next;
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
            if (!successive) {
                result++;
                successive = true;
            }
        } else {
            successive = false;
        }
        head = head->next;
    }

    return result;
}
```

```
        prev = prev->next;
```

```
// 迭代
ListNode *removeNodes(ListNode *head) {
    const auto& reverse = [](ListNode* head){
        ListNode dummy;
        ListNode* tail = &dummy;
        while(head){
            ListNode *node = head;
            head = head->next;
            node->next = tail->next;
            tail->next = node;
        }
        return dummy.next;
    };
    head = reverse(head);
    ListNode dummy(INT_MIN, head);
    ListNode *prev = &dummy;
    ListNode *curr = prev->next;
    while (curr) {
        if (curr->val < prev->val) {
            ListNode *node = curr;
            prev->next = curr->next;
            curr = curr->next;
            // delete node;
        } else {
            prev = prev->next;
            curr = curr->next;
        }
    }
    return reverse(dummy.next);
}

// 递归
ListNode *removeNodes(ListNode *head) {
    if (!head->next) {
        return head;
    }

    ListNode *node = removeNodes(head->next);
    if (node->val > head->val) {
        return node;
    }
    head->next = node;
    return head;
}
```

```
ListNode *insertionSortList(ListNode *head) {

        ListNode dummy(INT_MIN, head);
        ListNode *prev = &dummy;
        ListNode *curr = prev->next;
        while (curr) {

                prev->next = node;
                node->next = curr;

                curr = curr->next;
```

```
Node *insert(Node *head, int insertVal) {
    if (!head) {
        head = new Node(insertVal);
        head->next = head;
        return head;
    }

    Node *tail = head;
    Node *curr = head->next;
    while (curr != head) {
        if (tail->val <= curr->val) {
            tail = curr;
        }
        curr = curr->next;
    }
    Node *h = tail->next;

    Node dummy(INT_MIN, h);
    Node *prev = &dummy;
    curr = prev->next;
    Node *node = new Node(insertVal);
    while (prev != tail || curr != h) {
        if (curr->val > insertVal) {
            if (prev == &dummy) {
                prev = tail;
            }
            node->next = curr;
            prev->next = node;
            return head;
        }
        prev = prev->next;
        curr = curr->next;
    }
    node->next = curr;
    prev->next = node;
    return head;
}
```

```
ListNode *reverse(ListNode *head) {
    if (!head || !head->next) {
```

[92. 反转链表 II](https://leetcode.cn/problems/reverse-linked-list-ii/)

```
ListNode *reverseBetween(ListNode *head, int left, int right) {
    // 迭代
    // const auto& reverse = [](ListNode*head){
    //     ListNode dummy;
    //     while(head){
    //         ListNode *node = head;
    //         head = head->next;
    //         node->next = dummy.next;
    //         dummy.next = node;
    //     }
    //     return dummy.next;
    // };

    // 递归
    const function<ListNode *(ListNode *)> reverse = [&](ListNode *head) {
        if (!head || !head->next) {
            return head;
        }
        ListNode *node = reverse(head->next);
        head->next->next = head;
        head->next = nullptr;
        return node;
    };

    ListNode dummy(0, head);

    ListNode *prev = &dummy;
    for (int i = 0; i < left - 1; i++) {
        prev = prev->next;
    }

    ListNode *tail = prev;
    for (int i = 0; i < right - left + 1; i++) {
        tail = tail->next;
    }

    ListNode *list = prev->next;
    ListNode *succ = tail->next;

    prev->next = nullptr;
    tail->next = nullptr;

    reverse(list);
    prev->next = tail;
    list->next = succ;
    return dummy.next;
}
```

[24. 两两交换链表中的节点](https://leetcode.cn/problems/swap-nodes-in-pairs/)

```
ListNode *swapPairs(ListNode *head) {
    if (!head || !head->next) {
        return head;
    }

    // 迭代
    const auto &reverse = [](ListNode *head) {
        ListNode dummy;
        while (head) {
            ListNode *node = head;
            head = head->next;
            node->next = dummy.next;
            dummy.next = node;
        }
        return dummy.next;
    };

    ListNode dummy(0, head);
    ListNode *prev = &dummy;
    while (prev && prev->next && prev->next->next) {
        ListNode *list = prev->next;
        ListNode *tail = list->next;
        ListNode *succ = tail->next;

        prev->next = nullptr;
        tail->next = nullptr;

        reverse(list);
        prev->next = tail;
        list->next = succ;
        prev = list;
    }
    return dummy.next;
}
```

[25. K 个一组翻转链表](https://leetcode.cn/problems/reverse-nodes-in-k-group/)

```
ListNode *reverseKGroup(ListNode *head, int k) {
    const auto &size = [](ListNode *head) {
        int size = 0;
        while (head) {
            size++;
            head = head->next;
        }
        return size;
    };

    if (size(head) < k) {
        return head;
    }

    // 迭代
    const auto &reverse = [](ListNode *head) {
        ListNode dummy;
        while (head) {
            ListNode *node = head;
            head = head->next;
            node->next = dummy.next;
            dummy.next = node;
        }
        return dummy.next;
    };

    ListNode dummy(0, head);
    ListNode *prev = &dummy;
    while (prev && prev->next) {
        ListNode *list = prev->next;
        ListNode *tail = list;
        for (int i = 0; i < k - 1; i++) {
            tail = tail->next;
            if (!tail) {
                return dummy.next;
            }
        }
        ListNode *succ = tail->next;

        prev->next = nullptr;
        tail->next = nullptr;

        reverse(list);
        prev->next = tail;
        list->next = succ;
        prev = list;
    }
    return dummy.next;
}
```

[2074. 反转偶数长度组的节点](https://leetcode.cn/problems/reverse-nodes-in-even-length-groups/)

```
ListNode *reverseEvenLengthGroups(ListNode *head) {
    const auto &size = [](ListNode *head) {
        int size = 0;
        while (head) {
            size++;
            head = head->next;
        }
        return size;
    };

    int s = size(head);

    // 迭代
    const auto &reverse = [](ListNode *head) {
        ListNode dummy;
        while (head) {
            ListNode *node = head;
            head = head->next;
            node->next = dummy.next;
            dummy.next = node;
        }
        return dummy.next;
    };

    int k = 1;
    ListNode dummy(0, head);
    ListNode *prev = &dummy;
    while (prev && prev->next) {
        if (k % 2 == 1) {
            for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
                prev = prev->next;
                if (!prev) {
                    return dummy.next;
                }
            }
        } else {
            ListNode *list = prev->next;
            ListNode *tail = list;
            for (int i = 0; i < k - 1; i++) {
                tail = tail->next;
                if (!tail) {
                    return dummy.next;
                }
            }
            ListNode *succ = tail->next;

            prev->next = nullptr;
            tail->next = nullptr;

            reverse(list);
            prev->next = tail;
            list->next = succ;
            prev = list;
        }
        s -= k;
        k = s > k + 1 ? k + 1 : s;
    }
    return dummy.next;
}
```

```
ListNode *rotateRight(ListNode *head, int k) {
    if (!k || !head || !head->next) {
        return head;
    }

    const auto &size = [](ListNode *head) {
        int size = 0;
        while (head) {
            size++;
            head = head->next;
        }
        return size;
    };

    k = k % size(head);
    ListNode *slow = head;
    ListNode *fast = slow;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        fast = fast->next;
    }
    while (fast && fast->next) {
        slow = slow->next;
        fast = fast->next;
    }
    fast->next = head;
    head = slow->next;
    slow->next = nullptr;
    return head;
};
```

```
bool isPalindrome(ListNode *head) {
    if (!head || !head->next) {
        return true;
    }

    const auto &reverse = [](ListNode *head) {
        ListNode dummy;
        while (head) {
            ListNode *node = head;
            head = head->next;
            node->next = dummy.next;
            dummy.next = node;
        }
        return dummy.next;

    ListNode *fast = slow;
    while (fast->next && fast->next->next) {
        slow = slow->next;
        fast = fast->next->next;
    }
    ListNode *list = slow->next;
    slow->next = nullptr;
    list = reverse(list);
    while (head && list && head->val == list->val) {
        head = head->next;
        list = list->next;
    }
    return list == nullptr;
}
```

```
int pairSum(ListNode *head) {
    const auto &reverse = [](ListNode *head) {
        ListNode dummy;
        while (head) {
            ListNode *node = head;
            head = head->next;
            node->next = dummy.next;
            dummy.next = node;
        }
        return dummy.next;
    };
    ListNode *slow = head;
    ListNode *fast = slow;
    while (fast->next && fast->next->next) {
        slow = slow->next;
        fast = fast->next->next;
    }
    ListNode *list = slow->next;
    slow->next = nullptr;
    list = reverse(list);
    int result = 0;
    while (head && list) {
        result = max(result, head->val + list->val);
        head = head->next;
        list = list->next;
    }
    return result;
}
```

[457. 环形数组是否存在循环](https://leetcode.cn/problems/circular-array-loop/)

```
bool circularArrayLoop(vector<int> &nums) {
    auto next = [&](int cur) {
        return (cur + nums[cur] + nums.size()) % nums.size();
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        if (nums[i]) {
            int slow = i;
            int fast = next(i);
            while (nums[slow] * nums[fast] > 0 && nums[slow] * nums[next(fast)] > 0) {
                if (slow == fast) {
                    if (slow != next(slow)) {
                        return true;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                slow = next(slow);
                fast = next(next(fast));
            }
            int index = i;
            while (nums[index] * nums[next(index)] > 0) {
                int temp = index;
                index = next(index);
                nums[temp] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}
```

```
ListNode *partition(ListNode *head, int x) {
    ListNode left;
    ListNode *lt = &left;
    ListNode right;
    ListNode *rt = &right;
    while (head) {
        ListNode *node = head;
        head = head->next;
        node->next = nullptr;
        if (node->val < x) {
            lt->next = node;
            lt = lt->next;
        } else {

            rt = rt->next;

    lt->next = right.next;
    return left.next;
```

```
ListNode *mergeKLists(vector<ListNode *> &lists) {

        return nullptr;

    const auto &merge = [](ListNode *list1, ListNode *list2) {
        ListNode dummy;
        ListNode *tail = &dummy;
        while (list1 && list2) {
            if (list1->val <= list2->val) {
                tail->next = list1;
                tail = tail->next;
                list1 = list1->next;
            } else {
                tail->next = list2;
                tail = tail->next;
                list2 = list2->next;
            }
        }
        if (list1) {
            tail->next = list1;
        }
        if (list2) {
            tail->next = list2;
        }
        return dummy.next;
    };
    ListNode dummy(0, lists[0]);
    for (int i = 1; i < lists.size(); i++) {
        dummy.next = merge(dummy.next, lists[i]);
    }
    return dummy.next;
}
```

[1019. 链表中的下一个更大节点](https://leetcode.cn/problems/next-greater-node-in-linked-list/)

```
vector<int> nextLargerNodes(ListNode *head) {
    vector<int> nums;
    while (head) {
        nums.push_back(head->val);
        head = head->next;
    }
    stack<int> stack;
    vector<int> result(nums.size());
    for (int i = nums.size() - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        while (!stack.empty() && stack.top() <= nums[i]) {
            stack.pop();
        }
        result[i] = stack.empty() ? 0 : stack.top();
        stack.push(nums[i]);
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
ListNode *removeZeroSumSublists(ListNode *head) {

    unordered_map<int, ListNode *> map;
    int sum = 0;
    ListNode *curr = &dummy;
    while (curr) {
        sum += curr->val;
        map[sum] = curr;
        curr = curr->next;
    }

    sum = 0;
    curr = &dummy;
    while (curr) {
        sum += curr->val;
        curr->next = map[sum]->next;
        curr = curr->next;
    }
    return dummy.next;
```

[707. 设计链表](https://leetcode.cn/problems/design-linked-list/)

```
class MyLinkedList {
private:
    struct Node {
        int val;
        Node *next;

        Node() : val(0), next(nullptr) {}

        Node(int val) : val(val), next(nullptr) {}

        Node(int val, Node *next) : val(val), next(next) {}
    };

    Node *head;
    Node *tail;
    int size;

public:
    MyLinkedList() : head(nullptr), tail(nullptr), size(0) {}

    int get(int index) {
        if (index >= size) {
            return -1;
        }
        Node *node = head;
        for (int i = 0; i < index; i++) {
            node = node->next;
        }
        return node->val;
    }

    void addAtHead(int val) {
        Node *node = new Node(val);
        if (!head) {
            head = node;
            tail = node;
        } else {
            node->next = head;
            head = node;
        }
        size++;
    }

    void addAtTail(int val) {
        Node *node = new Node(val);
        if (!tail) {
            head = node;
            tail = node;
        } else {
            tail->next = node;
            tail = tail->next;
        }
        size++;
    }

    void addAtIndex(int index, int val) {
        if (index == 0) {
            addAtHead(val);
        } else if (index < size) {
            Node *node = head;
            for (int i = 0; i < index - 1; i++) {
                node = node->next;
            }
            Node *n = new Node(val);
            n->next = node->next;
            node->next = n;
            size++;
        } else if (index == size) {
            addAtTail(val);
        }
    }

    void deleteAtHead() {
        if (size == 0) {
            head = nullptr;
            tail = nullptr;
        } else if (size == 1) {
            delete head;
            head = nullptr;
            tail = nullptr;
            size--;
        } else {
            Node *node = head;
            head = head->next;
            delete node;
            size--;
        }
    }

    void deleteAtTail() {
        Node *node = head;
        for (int i = 0; i < size - 2; i++) {
            node = node->next;
        }
        delete node->next;
        node->next = nullptr;
        tail = node;
        size--;
    }

    void deleteAtIndex(int index) {
        if (index == 0) {
            deleteAtHead();
        } else if (index == size - 1) {
            deleteAtTail();
        } else if (index < size) {
            Node *node = head;
            for (int i = 0; i < index - 1; i++) {
                node = node->next;
            }
            Node *n = node->next;
            node->next = n->next;
            delete n;
            size--;
        }
    }
};
```

[146. LRU 缓存](https://leetcode.cn/problems/lru-cache/)

```
class LRUCache {
private:
    struct Node {
        int key;
        int value;
        Node *prev;
        Node *next;

        Node(int key, int value) : key(key), value(value), prev(this), next(this) {

        }
    };

    int capacity;
    unordered_map<int, Node *> map;
    Node head;

private:
    void insert(Node *node) {
        node->prev = &head;
        node->next = head.next;
        node->prev->next = node;
        node->next->prev = node;
    }

    void remove(Node *node) {
        node->prev->next = node->next;
        node->next->prev = node->prev;
    }

    Node *find(int key) {
        if (map.contains(key)) {
            Node *node = map[key];
            remove(node);
            insert(node);
            return node;
        } else {
            return nullptr;
        }
    }

public:
    LRUCache(int capacity) : capacity(capacity), head(0, 0) {

    }

    int get(int key) {
        Node *node = find(key);
        return node ? node->value : -1;
    }

    void put(int key, int value) {
        Node *node = find(key);
        if (node) {
            node->value = value;
        } else {
            node = new Node(key, value);
            insert(node);
            map[key] = node;
            if (map.size() > capacity) {
                Node *tail = head.prev;
                remove(tail);
                map.erase(tail->key);
                delete tail;
            }
        }
    }
};
```

```
Node *copyRandomList(Node *head) {
    unordered_map<Node *, Node *> map;
    Node dummy(0);
    Node *tail = &dummy;
    Node *curr = head;
    while (curr) {
        Node *node = new Node(curr->val);
        map[curr] = node;
        tail->next = node;
        tail = tail->next;
        curr = curr->next;
    }
    *curr = head;
    while (curr) {
        if (curr->random) {
            map[curr]->random = map[curr->random];
        }
        curr = curr->next;
    }
    return dummy.next;
}
```

[430. 扁平化多级双向链表](https://leetcode.cn/problems/flatten-a-multilevel-doubly-linked-list/)

```
Node *flatten(Node *head) {
    static const function<Node *(Node *)> f = [&](Node *head) {
        while (head && head->next) {
            if (head->child) {
                Node *tail = f(head->child);
                head->next->prev = tail;
                tail->next = head->next;
                head->child->prev = head;
                head->next = head->child;
                head->child = nullptr;
            }
            head = head->next;
        }
        return head;
    };
    Node *node = head;
    while (node && (node->next || node->child)) {
        if (node->next && node->child) {
            if (node->child) {
                Node *tail = f(node->child);
                node->next->prev = tail;
                tail->next = node->next;
                node->child->prev = node;
                node->next = node->child;
                node->child = nullptr;
            }
        } else if (node->child) {
            node->next = node->child;
            node->child->prev = node;
            node->child = nullptr;
        }
        node = node->next;
    }
    return head;
}
```

[623. 在二叉树中增加一行](https://leetcode.cn/problems/add-one-row-to-tree/)

```
TreeNode *addOneRow(TreeNode *root, int val, int depth) {
    if (root) {
        if (depth == 1) {
            return new TreeNode(val, root, nullptr);
        } else if (depth == 2) {
            root->left = new TreeNode(val, root->left, nullptr);
            root->right = new TreeNode(val, nullptr, root->right);
            return root;
        } else {
            queue<TreeNode *> queue;
            queue.push(root);
            int d = 1;
            while (!queue.empty()) {
                int size = queue.size();
                for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                    TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                    queue.pop();
                    if (node->left) {
                        queue.push(node->left);
                    }
                    if (node->right) {
                        queue.push(node->right);
                    }
                }
                d++;
                if (d + 1 == depth) {
                    int size = queue.size();
                    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                        TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                        queue.pop();
                        node->left = new TreeNode(val, node->left, nullptr);
                        node->right = new TreeNode(val, nullptr, node->right);
                    }
                    return root;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return root;
}
```

```
int longestZigZag(TreeNode *root) {
    int result = 0;
    // left:0 right:1
    const function<void(TreeNode *, bool, int)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root, bool direction, int current) {
        if (root) {
            result = max(result, current);
            if (direction) {
                dfs(root->left, !direction, current + 1);
                dfs(root->right, direction, 1);
            } else {
                dfs(root->left, direction, 1);
                dfs(root->right, !direction, current + 1);
            }
        }
    };
    dfs(root, false, 0);
    dfs(root, true, 0);
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<int> flipMatchVoyage(TreeNode *root, vector<int> &voyage) {
    vector<int> result;
    int index = 0;
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (root->val == voyage[index++]) {
                if (index < voyage.size() && root->left && root->left->val != voyage[index]) {
                    result.push_back(root->val);
                    dfs(root->right);
                    dfs(root->left);
                } else {
                    dfs(root->left);
                    dfs(root->right);
                }
            } else {
                result.clear();
                result.push_back(-1);
            }
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    if (!result.empty() && result[0] == -1) {
        result.clear();
        result.push_back(-1);
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
TreeNode *mergeTrees(TreeNode *root1, TreeNode *root2) {
    const function<TreeNode *(TreeNode *, TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *p, TreeNode *q) {
        if (p && q) {
            p->val += q->val;
            p->left = dfs(p->left, q->left);
            p->right = dfs(p->right, q->right);
            return p;
        } else if (p) {
            return p;
        } else if (q) {
            TreeNode *node = new TreeNode(q->val);
            node->left = dfs(nullptr, q->left);
            node->right = dfs(nullptr, q->right);
            return node;
        } else {
            return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
        }
    };
    return dfs(root1, root2);
}
```

[508. 出现次数最多的子树元素和](https://leetcode.cn/problems/most-frequent-subtree-sum/)

```
vector<int> findFrequentTreeSum(TreeNode *root) {
    int maximum = 0;
    unordered_map<int, int> counts;
    const function<int(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            int sum = root->val + dfs(root->left) + dfs(root->right);
            maximum = max(maximum, ++counts[sum]);
            return sum;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    };
    dfs(root);

    vector<int> result;
    for (auto &&[s, c]: counts) {
        if (c == maximum) {
            result.emplace_back(s);
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
int findTilt(TreeNode *root) {

    const function<int(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            int left = dfs(root->left);
            int right = dfs(root->right);
            result += abs(left - right);
            return root->val + left + right;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    return result;
}
```

```
int averageOfSubtree(TreeNode *root) {
    int result = 0;
    const function<pair<int, int>(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            auto &&[lv, lc] = dfs(root->left);
            auto &&[rv, rc] = dfs(root->right);
            int sum = root->val + lv + rv;
            int count = 1 + lc + rc;
            if (root->val == sum / count) {
                result++;
            }
            return pair<int, int>({sum, count});
        } else {
            return pair<int, int>({0, 0});
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    return result;
}
```

```
int maxAncestorDiff(TreeNode *root) {
    int result = INT_MIN;
    const function<void(TreeNode *, int, int)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root, int minimum, int maximum) {
        if (root) {
            maximum = max(maximum, root->val);
            minimum = min(minimum, root->val);
            result = max(result, maximum - minimum);
            dfs(root->left, minimum, maximum);
            dfs(root->right, minimum, maximum);
        }
    };
    dfs(root, INT_MAX, INT_MIN);
    return result;
}
```

[3319. 第 K 大的完美二叉子树的大小](https://leetcode.cn/problems/k-th-largest-perfect-subtree-size-in-binary-tree/)

```
int kthLargestPerfectSubtree(TreeNode *root, int k) {
    priority_queue<int> pq;
    const function<pair<bool, int>(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (!root->left && !root->right) {
                pq.push(1);
                return pair<bool, int>(true, 1);
            } else if (!root->left) {
                dfs(root->right);
                return pair<bool, int>(false, 0);
            } else if (!root->right) {
                dfs(root->left);
                return pair<bool, int>(false, 0);
            } else {
                auto &&[lp, lc] = dfs(root->left);
                auto &&[rp, rc] = dfs(root->right);
                if (lp && rp && lc == rc) {
                    pq.push(lc + rc + 1);
                    return pair<bool, int>(true, lc + rc + 1);
                } else {
                    return pair<bool, int>(false, 0);
                }
            }
        } else {
            return pair<bool, int>(false, 0);
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    if (pq.size() < k) {
        return -1;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < k - 1; i++) {
        pq.pop();
    }
    return pq.top();
}
```

[1339. 分裂二叉树的最大乘积](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-product-of-splitted-binary-tree/)

```
int maxProduct(TreeNode *root) {
    unsigned long long result = 0;
    const unsigned long long MOD = 1e9 + 7;
    const function<unsigned long long(TreeNode *)> sum = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        return root ? root->val + sum(root->left) + sum(root->right) : 0;
    };
    unsigned long long s = sum(root);
    const function<unsigned long long(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            unsigned long long current = root->val + dfs(root->left) + dfs(root->right);
            result = max(result, max(1ULL * (s - current) * current, 1ULL * (s - current) * current));
            return current;
        } else {
            return 0ULL;
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    return static_cast<int>(result % MOD);
}
```

[1372. 二叉树中的最长交错路径](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-zigzag-path-in-a-binary-tree/)

```
int longestZigZag(TreeNode *root) {
    int result = 0;
    // left:0 right:1
    const function<void(TreeNode *, bool, int)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root, bool direction, int current) {
        if (root) {
            result = max(result, current);
            if (direction) {
                dfs(root->left, !direction, current + 1);
                dfs(root->right, direction, 1);
            } else {
                dfs(root->left, direction, 1);
                dfs(root->right, !direction, current + 1);
            }
        }
    };
    dfs(root, false, 0);
    dfs(root, true, 0);
    return result;
}
```

```
bool btreeGameWinningMove(TreeNode *root, int n, int x) {
    int left = 0;
    int right = 0;
    const function<int(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            int l = dfs(root->left);
            int r = dfs(root->right);
            if (root->val == x) {
                left = l;
                right = r;
            }
            return 1 + l + r;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    return (n - left - right - 1) > n / 2 || left > n / 2 || right > n / 2;
}
```

[1530. 好叶子节点对的数量](https://leetcode.cn/problems/number-of-good-leaf-nodes-pairs/)

```
int countPairs(TreeNode *root, int distance) {
    int result = 0;
    const function<vector<int>(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (!root->left && !root->right) {
                return vector<int>({1});
            } else {
                auto left = dfs(root->left);
                auto right = dfs(root->right);
                for (int l: left) {
                    for (int r: right) {
                        if (l + r <= distance) {
                            result++;
                        }
                    }
                }

                vector<int> distances;
                for (int d: left) {
                    if (d + 1 < distance) {
                        distances.push_back(d + 1);
                    }
                }
                for (int d: right) {
                    if (d + 1 < distance) {
                        distances.push_back(d + 1);
                    }
                }
                return distances;
            }
        } else {
            return vector<int>();
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    return result;
}
```

[LCP 67. 装饰树](https://leetcode.cn/problems/KnLfVT/)

```
TreeNode *expandBinaryTree(TreeNode *root) {
    if (root) {
        if (!root->left && !root->right) {
            root->left = new TreeNode(-1);
            root->right = new TreeNode(-1);
        } else {
            queue<TreeNode *> queue;
            queue.push(root);
            while (!queue.empty()) {
                size_t size = queue.size();
                for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                    TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                    queue.pop();
                    if (node->left) {
                        TreeNode *left = node->left;
                        node->left = new TreeNode(-1, left, nullptr);
                        queue.push(left);
                    }
                    if (node->right) {
                        TreeNode *right = node->right;
                        node->right = new TreeNode(-1, nullptr, right);
                        queue.push(right);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return root;
}
```

[865. 具有所有最深节点的最小子树](https://leetcode.cn/problems/smallest-subtree-with-all-the-deepest-nodes/)

```
TreeNode *subtreeWithAllDeepest(TreeNode *root) {
    const function<pair<int, TreeNode *>(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            auto &&[ld, ll] = dfs(root->left);
            auto &&[rd, rl] = dfs(root->right);
            if (ld > rd) {
                return pair<int, TreeNode *>({ld + 1, ll});
            } else if (ld < rd) {
                return pair<int, TreeNode *>({rd + 1, rl});
            } else {
                return pair<int, TreeNode *>({ld + 1, root});
            }
        } else {
            return pair<int, TreeNode *>({0, nullptr});
        }
    };
    return dfs(root).second;
}
```

[1080. 根到叶路径上的不足节点](https://leetcode.cn/problems/insufficient-nodes-in-root-to-leaf-paths/)

```
TreeNode *sufficientSubset(TreeNode *root, int limit) {
    const function<bool(TreeNode *, int)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root, int sum) {
        if (root) {
            if (!root->left && !root->right) {
                return root->val + sum >= limit;
            } else if (!root->left) {
                bool right = dfs(root->right, sum + root->val);
                if (!right) {
                    root->right = nullptr;
                }
                return right;
            } else if (!root->right) {
                bool left = dfs(root->left, sum + root->val);
                if (!left) {
                    root->left = nullptr;
                }
                return left;
            } else {
                bool left = dfs(root->left, sum + root->val);
                if (!left) {
                    root->left = nullptr;
                }
                bool right = dfs(root->right, sum + root->val);
                if (!right) {
                    root->right = nullptr;
                }
                return left || right;
            }
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    };
    return dfs(root, 0) ? root : nullptr;
}
```

```
vector<vector<int>> levelOrder(TreeNode *root) {

            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {

                queue.pop();
```
