```
vector<vector<int>> zigzagLevelOrder(TreeNode *root) {
    vector<vector<int>> result;
    if (root) {
        queue<TreeNode *> queue;
        queue.push(root);
        bool direction = true;
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            vector<int> level;
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                level.emplace_back(node->val);
                if (node->left) {
                    queue.push(node->left);
                }
                if (node->right) {
                    queue.push(node->right);
                }
            }
            if (!direction) {
                reverse(level.begin(), level.end());
            }
            result.emplace_back(level);
            direction = !direction;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
bool isCousins(TreeNode *root, int x, int y) {
    if (root) {
        queue<TreeNode *> queue;
        queue.push(root);
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            set<int> level;
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                if (node->left && node->right && (node->left->val == x && node->right->val == y || node->left->val == y && node->right->val == x)) {
                    return false;
                }
                level.insert(node->val);
                if (node->left) {
                    queue.push(node->left);
                }
                if (node->right) {
                    queue.push(node->right);
                }
            }
            if (level.contains(x) && level.contains(y)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}
```

```
TreeNode *reverseOddLevels(TreeNode *root) {
    if (root) {
        queue<TreeNode *> queue;
        queue.push(root);
        int depth = 0;
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            vector<TreeNode *> level;
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                level.emplace_back(node);
                if (node->left) {
                    queue.push(node->left);
                }
                if (node->right) {
                    queue.push(node->right);
                }
            }
            if (depth % 2 == 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < level.size() / 2; i++) {
                    swap(level[i]->val, level[level.size() - i - 1]->val);
                }
            }
            depth++;
        }
    }
    return root;
}
```

[1609. 奇偶树](https://leetcode.cn/problems/even-odd-tree/)

```
bool isEvenOddTree(TreeNode *root) {
    if (root) {
        queue<TreeNode *> queue;
        queue.push(root);
        int depth = 0;
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            vector<int> level;
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                if (depth % 2 == 0) {
                    if (node->val % 2 == 0) {
                        return false;
                    } else {
                        if (!level.empty() && node->val <= level.back()) {
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                } else {
                    if (node->val % 2 == 1) {
                        return false;
                    } else {
                        if (!level.empty() && node->val >= level.back()) {
                            return false;
                        }
                    }
                }
                level.emplace_back(node->val);
                if (node->left) {
                    queue.push(node->left);
                }
                if (node->right) {
                    queue.push(node->right);
                }
            }
            depth++;
        }
    }
    return true;
}
```

```
TreeNode *addOneRow(TreeNode *root, int val, int depth) {
    if (root) {
        if (depth == 1) {
            return new TreeNode(val, root, nullptr);
        } else if (depth == 2) {
            root->left = new TreeNode(val, root->left, nullptr);
            root->right = new TreeNode(val, nullptr, root->right);
            return root;
        } else {
            queue<TreeNode *> queue;
            queue.push(root);
            int d = 1;
            while (!queue.empty()) {
                int size = queue.size();
                for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                    TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                    queue.pop();
                    if (node->left) {
                        queue.push(node->left);
                    }
                    if (node->right) {
                        queue.push(node->right);
                    }
                }
                d++;
                if (d + 1 == depth) {
                    int size = queue.size();
                    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                        TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                        queue.pop();
                        node->left = new TreeNode(val, node->left, nullptr);
                        node->right = new TreeNode(val, nullptr, node->right);
                    }
                    return root;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return root;
}
```

[2471. 逐层排序二叉树所需的最少操作数目](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-number-of-operations-to-sort-a-binary-tree-by-level/)

```
int minimumOperations(TreeNode *root) {
    int result = 0;
    if (root) {
        queue<TreeNode *> queue;
        queue.push(root);
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            vector<int> level;
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                level.emplace_back(node->val);
                if (node->left) {
                    queue.push(node->left);
                }
                if (node->right) {
                    queue.push(node->right);
                }
            }
            // 置换环算法
            int loop = 0;
            vector<int> sorted(level.begin(), level.end());
            sort(sorted.begin(), sorted.end());
            unordered_map<int, int> map;
            for (int i = 0; i < level.size(); i++) {
                map[sorted[i]] = i;
            }
            vector<bool> visited(level.size());
            for (int i = 0; i < level.size(); i++) {
                if (!visited[i]) {
                    int j = i;
                    while (!visited[j]) {
                        int index = map[level[j]];
                        visited[j] = true;
                        j = index;
                    }
                    loop++;
                }
            }
            result += level.size() - loop;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[2641. 二叉树的堂兄弟节点 II](https://leetcode.cn/problems/cousins-in-binary-tree-ii/)

```
TreeNode *replaceValueInTree(TreeNode *root) {
    if (root) {
        root->val = 0;
        queue<TreeNode *> queue;
        queue.push(root);
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            unordered_map<TreeNode *, vector<TreeNode *>> nodes;
            int sum = 0;
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                if (node->left) {
                    queue.push(node->left);
                    nodes[node].emplace_back(node->left);
                    sum += node->left->val;
                }
                if (node->right) {
                    queue.push(node->right);
                    nodes[node].emplace_back(node->right);
                    sum += node->right->val;
                }
            }
            for (auto &&[parent, children]: nodes) {
                int s = 0;
                for (const auto &child: children) {
                    s += child->val;
                }
                for (const auto &child: children) {
                    child->val = sum - s;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return root;
}
```

[919. 完全二叉树插入器](https://leetcode.cn/problems/complete-binary-tree-inserter/)

```
class CBTInserter {
private:
    TreeNode *root;
    vector<TreeNode *> tree;

public:
    CBTInserter(TreeNode *root) : root(root) {
        queue<TreeNode *> queue;
        queue.push(root);
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                tree.push_back(node);
                if (node->left) {
                    queue.push(node->left);
                }
                if (node->right) {
                    queue.push(node->right);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    int insert(int val) {
        TreeNode *node = new TreeNode(val);
        if (!tree[(tree.size() - 1) / 2]->left) {
            tree[(tree.size() - 1) / 2]->left = node;
        } else {
            tree[(tree.size() - 1) / 2]->right = node;
        }
        int v = tree[(tree.size() - 1) / 2]->val;
        tree.push_back(node);
        return v;
    }

    TreeNode *get_root() {
        return root;
    }
};
```

[958. 二叉树的完全性检验](https://leetcode.cn/problems/check-completeness-of-a-binary-tree/)

```
bool isCompleteTree(TreeNode *root) {
    if (root) {
        queue<TreeNode *> queue;
        queue.push(root);
        bool flag = false;
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                TreeNode *node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                if (!node) {
                    flag = true;
                } else {
                    if (flag) {
                        return false;
                    }
                    queue.push(node->left);
                    queue.push(node->right);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return true;
}
```

[863. 二叉树中所有距离为 K 的结点](https://leetcode.cn/problems/all-nodes-distance-k-in-binary-tree/)

```
vector<int> distanceK(TreeNode *root, TreeNode *target, int k) {
    unordered_map<int, unordered_set<int>> graph;
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (root->left) {
                graph[root->val].insert(root->left->val);
                graph[root->left->val].insert(root->val);
                dfs(root->left);
            }
            if (root->right) {
                graph[root->val].insert(root->right->val);
                graph[root->right->val].insert(root->val);
                dfs(root->right);
            }
        }
    };
    dfs(root);


    unordered_map<int, bool> visited;
    const function<vector<int>(void)> bfs = [&]() {
        int distance = 0;
        queue<int> queue;
        queue.push(target->val);
        while (distance < k) {
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                int node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                visited[node] = true;
                for (const auto &neighbor: graph[node]) {
                    if (!visited[neighbor]) {
                        queue.push(neighbor);
                    }
                }
            }
            distance++;
        }
        vector<int> result;
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            result.emplace_back(queue.front());
            queue.pop();
        }
        return result;
    };
    return bfs();
}
```

[662. 二叉树最大宽度](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-width-of-binary-tree/)

```
int widthOfBinaryTree(TreeNode *root) {
    unsigned long long result = 0;
    if (root) {
        queue<pair<TreeNode *, unsigned long long>> queue;
        queue.emplace(root, 1);
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            vector<unsigned long long> level;
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                auto [node, index] = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                level.emplace_back(index);
                if (node->left) {
                    queue.emplace(node->left, index * 2);
                }
                if (node->right) {
                    queue.emplace(node->right, index * 2 + 1);
                }
                result = max(result, level.back() - level.front() + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    return static_cast<int>(result);
}
```

```
                return root;
```

```
vector<TreeNode *> delNodes(TreeNode *root, vector<int> &to_delete) {
    unordered_set<int> set(to_delete.begin(), to_delete.end());
    vector<TreeNode *> result;
    const function<TreeNode *(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            root->left = dfs(root->left);
            root->right = dfs(root->right);
            if (!set.contains(root->val)) {
                return root;
            }
            if (root->left) {
                result.push_back(root->left);
            }
            if (root->right) {
                result.push_back(root->right);
            }
            return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
        } else {
            return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
        }
    };
    if (dfs(root)) {
        result.push_back(root);
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<string> binaryTreePaths(TreeNode *root) {

        if (root) {
            if (!root->left && !root->right) {
                result.emplace_back(path + to_string(root->val));
            } else if (!root->left) {
                dfs(root->right, path + to_string(root->val) + "->");
            } else if (!root->right) {
                dfs(root->left, path + to_string(root->val) + "->");
            } else {
                dfs(root->left, path + to_string(root->val) + "->");
                dfs(root->right, path + to_string(root->val) + "->");

        }
    };

}
```

[113. 路径总和 II](https://leetcode.cn/problems/path-sum-ii/)

```
vector<vector<int>> pathSum(TreeNode *root, int targetSum) {
    vector<vector<int>> result;
    vector<int> path;
    const function<void(TreeNode *, int)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root, int sum) {
        if (root) {
            path.emplace_back(root->val);
            if (!root->left && !root->right) {
                if (sum + root->val == targetSum) {
                    result.emplace_back(path);
                }
            } else if (!root->left) {
                dfs(root->right, sum + root->val);
            } else if (!root->right) {
                dfs(root->left, sum + root->val);
            } else {
                dfs(root->left, sum + root->val);
                dfs(root->right, sum + root->val);
            }
            path.pop_back();
        }
    };
    dfs(root, 0);
    return result;
}
```

```
int pseudoPalindromicPaths(TreeNode *root) {
    vector<int> count(10);
    const function<int(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            count[root->val] ^= 1;
            int result;
            if (!root->left && !root->right) {
                result = accumulate(count.begin(), count.end(), 0) <= 1;
            } else {
                result = dfs(root->left) + dfs(root->right);
            }
            count[root->val] ^= 1;
            return result;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    };
    return dfs(root);
}
```

```
int longestUnivaluePath(TreeNode *root) {
    int result = 0;
    const function<int(TreeNode *, int)> path = [&](TreeNode *root, int target) {
        if (root && root->val == target) {
            int left = path(root->left, target);
            int right = path(root->right, target);
            result = max(result, left + right);
            return 1 + max(left, right);
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    };
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            path(root, root->val);
            dfs(root->left);
            dfs(root->right);
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    return result;
}
```

```
int amountOfTime(TreeNode *root, int start) {
    unordered_map<int, unordered_set<int>> graph;
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (root->left) {
                graph[root->val].insert(root->left->val);
                graph[root->left->val].insert(root->val);
                dfs(root->left);
            }
            if (root->right) {
                graph[root->val].insert(root->right->val);
                graph[root->right->val].insert(root->val);
                dfs(root->right);
            }
        }
    };
    dfs(root);

    unordered_map<int, bool> visited;
    const function<int(void)> bfs = [&]() {
        int result = 0;
        queue<int> queue;
        queue.push(start);
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                int node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                visited[node] = true;
                for (const auto &neighbor: graph[node]) {
                    if (!visited[neighbor]) {
                        queue.push(neighbor);
                    }
                }
            }
            result++;
        }
        return result - 1;
    };
    return bfs();
}
```

```
TreeNode *lowestCommonAncestor(TreeNode *root, TreeNode *p, TreeNode *q) {
    const function<TreeNode *(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (root == p || root == q) {
                return root;
            } else {
                TreeNode *left = dfs(root->left);
                TreeNode *right = dfs(root->right);
                if (left && right) {
                    return root;
                } else if (left) {
                    return left;
                } else if (right) {
                    return right;
                } else {
                    return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
                }
            }
        } else {
            return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
        }
    };
    return dfs(root);
}
```

[1123. 最深叶节点的最近公共祖先](https://leetcode.cn/problems/lowest-common-ancestor-of-deepest-leaves/)

```
TreeNode *lcaDeepestLeaves(TreeNode *root) {
    const function<pair<int, TreeNode *>(TreeNode *)> dfs =
            [&](TreeNode *root) {
                if (root) {
                    auto &&[ld, ll] = dfs(root->left);
                    auto &&[rd, rl] = dfs(root->right);
                    if (ld > rd) {
                        return pair<int, TreeNode *>({ld + 1, ll});
                    } else if (ld < rd) {
                        return pair<int, TreeNode *>({rd + 1, rl});
                    } else {
                        return pair<int, TreeNode *>({ld + 1, root});
                    }
                } else {
                    return pair<int, TreeNode *>({0, nullptr});
                }
            };
    return dfs(root).second;
}
```

[2096. 从二叉树一个节点到另一个节点每一步的方向](https://leetcode.cn/problems/step-by-step-directions-from-a-binary-tree-node-to-another/)

```
string getDirections(TreeNode *root, int startValue, int destValue) {
    string path;
    string spath;
    string dpath;
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (root->val == startValue) {
                spath = path;
            } else if (root->val == destValue) {
                dpath = path;
            }

            path.push_back('L');
            dfs(root->left);
            path.pop_back();

            path.push_back('R');
            dfs(root->right);
            path.pop_back();
        }
    };

    dfs(root);

    int i = 0;
    while (i < spath.size() && i < dpath.size() && spath[i] == dpath[i]) {
        i++;
    }

    return string(spath.size() - i, 'U') + dpath.substr(i);
}
```

```
        } else if (root->val > val) {

        } else {

}
```

```
int rangeSumBST(TreeNode *root, int low, int high) {
    if (root) {
        if (low <= root->val && root->val <= high) {
            return root->val + rangeSumBST(root->left, low, high) + rangeSumBST(root->right, low, high);
        } else if (low <= root->val) {
            return rangeSumBST(root->left, low, high);
        } else if (root->val <= high) {
            return rangeSumBST(root->right, low, high);
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    } else {
        return 0;
    }
}
```

```
vector<int> findMode(TreeNode *root) {
    unordered_map<int, int> counts;
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            counts[root->val]++;
            dfs(root->left);
            dfs(root->right);
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    int maximum = 0;
    for (auto &&[_, count]: counts) {
        maximum = max(maximum, count);
    }
    vector<int> result;
    for (auto &&[num, count]: counts) {
        if (count == maximum) {
            result.emplace_back(num);
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<int> getAllElements(TreeNode *root1, TreeNode *root2) {
    const function<void(TreeNode *, vector<int> &nums)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root, vector<int> &nums) {
        if (root) {
            dfs(root->left, nums);
            nums.emplace_back(root->val);
            dfs(root->right, nums);
        }
    };
    vector<int> nums1;
    dfs(root1, nums1);
    vector<int> nums2;
    dfs(root2, nums2);
    vector<int> result(nums1.size() + nums2.size());
    int i = 0;
    int j = 0;
    int k = 0;
    while (i < nums1.size() && j < nums2.size()) {
        if (nums1[i] < nums2[j]) {
            result[k++] = nums1[i++];
        } else {
            result[k++] = nums2[j++];
        }
    }
    while (i < nums1.size()) {
        result[k++] = nums1[i++];
    }
    while (j < nums2.size()) {
        result[k++] = nums2[j++];
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
void recoverTree(TreeNode *root) {
    vector<int> nums;
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            nums.emplace_back(root->val);
            dfs(root->left);
            dfs(root->right);
        }
    };
    dfs(root);

    sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());

    int i = 0;
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> recover = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            recover(root->left);
            root->val = nums[i++];
            recover(root->right);
        }
    };
    recover(root);
}
```

```
    TreeNode *tail = &result;
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            dfs(root->left);
            root->left = nullptr;
            tail->right = root;
            tail = tail->right;
            dfs(root->right);
        }
    };
```

[2476. 二叉搜索树最近节点查询](https://leetcode.cn/problems/closest-nodes-queries-in-a-binary-search-tree/)

```
vector<vector<int>> closestNodes(TreeNode *root, vector<int> &queries) {
    vector<int> nums;
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            dfs(root->left);
            nums.emplace_back(root->val);
            dfs(root->right);
        }
    };
    dfs(root);

    vector<vector<int>> result(queries.size(), vector<int>(2, -1));
    for (int i = 0; i < queries.size(); i++) {
        int lower = lower_bound(nums.begin(), nums.end(), queries[i] + 1) - nums.begin() - 1;
        if (lower >= 0) {
            result[i][0] = nums[lower];
        }
        int upper = lower_bound(nums.begin(), nums.end(), queries[i]) - nums.begin();
        if (upper < nums.size()) {
            result[i][1] = nums[upper];
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
bool findTarget(TreeNode *root, int k) {
    unordered_set<int> set;
    const function<bool(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (set.contains(k - root->val)) {
                return true;
            }
            set.insert(root->val);
            return dfs(root->left) || dfs(root->right);
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    };
    return dfs(root);
}
```

```
TreeNode *sortedArrayToBST(vector<int> &nums) {
    const function<TreeNode *(int, int)> build = [&](int left, int right) {
        if (left < right) {
            int mid = left + (right - left) / 2;
            TreeNode *root = new TreeNode(nums[mid]);
            root->left = build(left, mid);
            root->right = build(mid + 1, right);
            return root;
        } else {
            return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
        }
    };
    return build(0, nums.size());
}
```

```
            root->left = build(left, mid);
            root->right = build(mid + 1, right);
```

[2196. 根据描述创建二叉树](https://leetcode.cn/problems/create-binary-tree-from-descriptions/)

```
TreeNode *createBinaryTree(vector<vector<int>> &descriptions) {
    unordered_set<int> children;
    unordered_map<int, pair<int, int>> ptoc;
    for (const auto &description: descriptions) {
        children.insert(description[1]);
        if (description[2]) {
            ptoc[description[0]].first = description[1];
        } else {
            ptoc[description[0]].second = description[1];
        }
    }
    TreeNode *root = nullptr;
    for (const auto &description: descriptions) {
        if (!children.contains(description[0])) {
            root = new TreeNode(description[0]);
            break;
        }
    }
    const function<TreeNode *(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (ptoc.contains(root->val)) {
                if (ptoc[root->val].first) {
                    root->left = new TreeNode(ptoc[root->val].first);
                    dfs(root->left);
                }
                if (ptoc[root->val].second) {
                    root->right = new TreeNode(ptoc[root->val].second);
                    dfs(root->right);
                }
                return root;
            } else {
                return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
            }
        } else {
            return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
        }
    };
    return dfs(root);
}
```

[106. 从中序与后序遍历序列构造二叉树](https://leetcode.cn/problems/construct-binary-tree-from-inorder-and-postorder-traversal/)

```
TreeNode *buildTree(vector<int> &inorder, vector<int> &postorder) {
    unordered_map<int, int> map;
    for (int i = 0; i < inorder.size(); i++) {
        map[inorder[i]] = i;
    }

    int index = postorder.size() - 1;
    const function<TreeNode *(int, int)> build = [&](int left, int right) {
        if (left < right) {
            int mid = map[postorder[index--]];
            TreeNode *root = new TreeNode(inorder[mid]);
            root->right = build(mid + 1, right);
            root->left = build(left, mid);
            return root;
        } else {
            return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
        }
    };
    return build(0, inorder.size());
}
```

[889. 根据前序和后序遍历构造二叉树](https://leetcode.cn/problems/construct-binary-tree-from-preorder-and-postorder-traversal/)

```
TreeNode *constructFromPrePost(vector<int> &preorder, vector<int> &postorder) {
    unordered_map<int, int> map;
    for (int i = 0; i < postorder.size(); i++) {
        map[postorder[i]] = i;
    }

    const function<TreeNode *(int, int, int, int)> build = [&](int l1, int r1, int l2, int r2) {
        if (l1 < r1 - 1) {
            int mid = map[preorder[l1 + 1]];
            int size = mid - l2 + 1;
            TreeNode *root = new TreeNode(preorder[l1]);
            root->left = build(l1 + 1, l1 + size + 1, l2, mid + 1);
            root->right = build(l1 + size + 1, r1, mid + 1, r2 - 1);
            return root;
        } else if (l1 == r1 - 1) {
            return new TreeNode(preorder[l1]);
        } else {
            return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
        }
    };
    return build(0, preorder.size(), 0, postorder.size());
}
```

[1028. 从先序遍历还原二叉树](https://leetcode.cn/problems/recover-a-tree-from-preorder-traversal/)

```
TreeNode *recoverFromPreorder(string traversal) {
    stack<TreeNode *> stack;
    int index = 0;
    while (index < traversal.size()) {
        int level = 0;
        while (traversal[index] == '-') {
            level++;
            index++;
        }

        int value = 0;
        while (index < traversal.size() && isdigit(traversal[index])) {
            value = value * 10 + (traversal[index] - '0');
            index++;
        }

        TreeNode *node = new TreeNode(value);
        if (level == stack.size()) {
            if (!stack.empty()) {
                stack.top()->left = node;
            }
        } else {
            while (level != stack.size()) {
                stack.pop();
            }
            stack.top()->right = node;
        }
        stack.push(node);
    }
    while (stack.size() > 1) {
        stack.pop();
    }
    return stack.top();
}
```

#### 插入

[701. 二叉搜索树中的插入操作](https://leetcode.cn/problems/insert-into-a-binary-search-tree/)

```
TreeNode *insertIntoBST(TreeNode *root, int val) {
    const function<void(TreeNode *, int, int)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root, int minimum, int maximum) {
        if (root) {
            if (!root->left && !root->right) {
                if (val < root->val) {
                    root->left = new TreeNode(val);
                } else {
                    root->right = new TreeNode(val);
                }
            } else if (!root->left) {
                if (val < root->val) {
                    root->left = new TreeNode(val);
                } else {
                    dfs(root->right, root->val, maximum);
                }
            } else if (!root->right) {
                if (val < root->val) {
                    dfs(root->left, minimum, root->val);
                } else {
                    root->right = new TreeNode(val);
                }
            } else {
                if (val < root->val) {
                    dfs(root->left, minimum, root->val);
                } else {
                    dfs(root->right, root->val, maximum);
                }
            }
        }
    };
    if (root) {
        dfs(root, INT_MIN, INT_MAX);
        return root;
    } else {
        return new TreeNode(val);
    }
}
```

[450. 删除二叉搜索树中的节点](https://leetcode.cn/problems/delete-node-in-a-bst/)

```
TreeNode *deleteNode(TreeNode *root, int key) {
    const function<TreeNode *(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (key == root->val) {
                if (root->left && root->right) {
                    TreeNode *successor = root->right;
                    while (successor->left) {
                        successor = successor->left;
                    }
                    successor->left = root->left;
                    return root->right;
                } else if (root->left) {
                    return root->left;
                } else if (root->right) {
                    return root->right;
                } else {
                    return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
                }
            } else if (key < root->val) {
                root->left = dfs(root->left);
                return root;
            } else {
                root->right = dfs(root->right);
                return root;
            }
        } else {
            return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
        }
    };
    return dfs(root);
}
```

```
TreeNode *trimBST(TreeNode *root, int low, int high) {
    const function<TreeNode *(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (low <= root->val && root->val <= high) {
                root->left = dfs(root->left);
                root->right = dfs(root->right);
                return root;
            } else if (low <= root->val) {
                return dfs(root->left);
            } else if (root->val <= high) {
                return dfs(root->right);
            } else {
                return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
            }
        } else {
            return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
        }
    };
    return dfs(root);
}
```

```
            sum += root->val;
```

```
void flatten(TreeNode *root) {
    vector<TreeNode *> nodes;
    const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            nodes.emplace_back(root);
            dfs(root->left);
            dfs(root->right);
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    for (int i = 0; i < nodes.size(); i++) {
        if (i != nodes.size() - 1) {
            nodes[i]->left = nullptr;
            nodes[i]->right = nodes[i + 1];
        } else {
            nodes[i]->left = nullptr;
            nodes[i]->right = nullptr;
        }
    }
}
```

[1367. 二叉树中的链表](https://leetcode.cn/problems/linked-list-in-binary-tree/)

```
bool isSubPath(ListNode *head, TreeNode *root) {
    const function<bool(TreeNode *, ListNode *)> compare = [&](TreeNode *p, ListNode *q) {
        if (p && q) {
            if (p->val == q->val) {
                return compare(p->left, q->next) || compare(p->right, q->next);
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        } else if (!p && !q) {
            return true;
        } else if (!q) {
            return true;
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    };

    const function<bool(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            if (compare(root, head)) {
                return true;
            } else {
                return dfs(root->left) || dfs(root->right);
            }
        } else {
            return false;
        }
    };
    return dfs(root);
}
```

[116. 填充每个节点的下一个右侧节点指针](https://leetcode.cn/problems/populating-next-right-pointers-in-each-node/)

```
Node *connect(Node *root) {
    if (root) {
        queue<Node *> queue;
        queue.push(root);
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            size_t size = queue.size();
            Node *previous = nullptr;
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                Node *node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                if (previous) {
                    previous->next = node;
                }
                previous = node;
                if (node->left) {
                    queue.push(node->left);
                }
                if (node->right) {
                    queue.push(node->right);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return root;
}
```

[1261. 在受污染的二叉树中查找元素](https://leetcode.cn/problems/find-elements-in-a-contaminated-binary-tree/)

```
class FindElements {
private:
    TreeNode *root;
public:
    FindElements(TreeNode *root) : root(root) {
        const function<void(TreeNode *, int)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root, int val) {
            if (root) {
                root->val = val;
                dfs(root->left, 2 * val + 1);
                dfs(root->right, 2 * val + 2);
            }
        };
        dfs(root, 0);
    }

    bool find(int target) {
        const function<bool(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
            if (root) {
                if (root->val == target) {
                    return true;
                } else {
                    return dfs(root->left) || dfs(root->right);
                }
            } else {
                return false;
            }
        };
        return dfs(root);
    }
};
```

[1104. 二叉树寻路](https://leetcode.cn/problems/path-in-zigzag-labelled-binary-tree/)

```
vector<int> pathInZigZagTree(int label) {
    int depth = log(label) + 1;
    vector<int> result(depth);
    while (depth) {
        result[depth - 1] = label;
        label = (pow(2, depth - 1) + pow(2, depth) - 1 - label) / 2;
        depth--;
    }
    return result;
}
```

[987. 二叉树的垂序遍历](https://leetcode.cn/problems/vertical-order-traversal-of-a-binary-tree/)

```
vector<vector<int>> verticalTraversal(TreeNode *root) {
    vector<tuple<int, int, int>> nodes;
    function<void(TreeNode *, int, int)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *node, int x, int y) {
        if (node) {
            nodes.emplace_back(x, y, node->val);
            dfs(node->left, x - 1, y + 1);
            dfs(node->right, x + 1, y + 1);
        }
    };
    dfs(root, 0, 0);

    sort(nodes.begin(), nodes.end());

    vector<vector<int>> result;
    int previous = INT_MIN;
    for (auto &[x, y, v]: nodes) {
        if (x != previous) {
            result.emplace_back();
            previous = x;
        }
        result.back().push_back(v);
    }
    return result;
}
```

[655. 输出二叉树](https://leetcode.cn/problems/print-binary-tree/)

```
vector<vector<string>> printTree(TreeNode *root) {
    const function<int(TreeNode *)> depth = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        return root ? 1 + max(depth(root->left), depth(root->right)) : 0;
    };

    int m = depth(root);
    int n = pow(2, m) - 1;
    vector<vector<string>> result(m, vector<string>(n));
    const function<void(TreeNode *, int, int)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root, int r, int c) {
        if (root) {
            result[r][c] = to_string(root->val);
            dfs(root->left, r + 1, c - pow(2, m - 1 - r - 1));
            dfs(root->right, r + 1, c + pow(2, m - 1 - r - 1));
        }
    };
    dfs(root, 0, (n - 1) / 2);
    return result;
}
```

[979. 在二叉树中分配硬币](https://leetcode.cn/problems/distribute-coins-in-binary-tree/)

```
int distributeCoins(TreeNode *root) {
    int result = 0;
    const function<pair<int, int>(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            auto [lc, ln] = dfs(root->left);
            auto [rc, rn] = dfs(root->right);
            int coins = root->val + lc + rc;
            int nodes = 1 + ln + rn;
            result += abs(coins - nodes);
            return pair<int, int>(coins, nodes);
        } else {
            return pair<int, int>(0, 0);
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    return result;
}
```

[297. 二叉树的序列化与反序列化](https://leetcode.cn/problems/serialize-and-deserialize-binary-tree/)

```
class Codec {
public:
    // Encodes a tree to a single string.
    string serialize(TreeNode *root) {
        string result;
        const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
            if (root) {
                result += to_string(root->val) + ",";
                dfs(root->left);
                dfs(root->right);
            } else {
                result += "#,";
            }
        };
        dfs(root);
        return result;
    }

    // Decodes your encoded data to tree.
    TreeNode *deserialize(string data) {
        const auto split = [&]() {
            vector<string> result;
            size_t begin = 0;
            size_t end = data.find(',', begin);
            while (end != string::npos) {
                result.emplace_back(data.substr(begin, end - begin));
                begin = end + 1;
                end = data.find(',', begin);
            }
            if (begin < data.size()) {
                result.emplace_back(data.substr(begin));
            }
            return result;
        };

        vector<string> strings = split();
        const function<TreeNode *()> build = [&]() {
            if (strings.front() != "#") {
                TreeNode *root = new TreeNode(stoi(strings.front()));
                strings.erase(strings.begin());
                root->left = build();
                root->right = build();
                return root;
            } else {
                strings.erase(strings.begin());
                return static_cast<TreeNode *>(nullptr);
            }
        };
        return build();
    }
};
```

[331. 验证二叉树的前序序列化](https://leetcode.cn/problems/verify-preorder-serialization-of-a-binary-tree/)

```
bool isValidSerialization(string preorder) {
    int n = preorder.length();
    int i = 0;
    stack<int> stack;
    stack.push(1);
    while (i < n) {
        if (stack.empty()) {
            return false;
        }
        if (preorder[i] == ',') {
            i++;
        } else if (preorder[i] == '#') {
            stack.top() -= 1;
            if (stack.top() == 0) {
                stack.pop();
            }
            i++;
        } else {
            while (i < n && preorder[i] != ',') {
                i++;
            }
            stack.top() -= 1;
            if (stack.top() == 0) {
                stack.pop();
            }
            stack.push(2);
        }
    }
    return stack.empty();
}
```

```
vector<TreeNode *> findDuplicateSubtrees(TreeNode *root) {
    unordered_map<string, TreeNode *> map;
    unordered_set<TreeNode *> set;
    const function<string(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            string serial = to_string(root->val) + "(" + dfs(root->left) + ")" + "(" + dfs(root->right) + ")";
            if (auto it = map.find(serial); it != map.end()) {
                set.insert(it->second);
            } else {
                map[serial] = root;
            }
            return serial;
        } else {
            return string();
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    return {set.begin(), set.end()};
}
```

```
class BSTIterator {
private:
    int index;
    vector<int> nums;
public:
    BSTIterator(TreeNode *root) : index(0) {
        const function<void(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
            if (root) {
                dfs(root->left);
                nums.emplace_back(root->val);
                dfs(root->right);
            }
        };
        dfs(root);
    }

    int next() {
        return nums[index++];
    }

    bool hasNext() {
        return index < nums.size();
    }
};
```

```
int maxDepth(Node *root) {
    const function<int(Node *)> dfs = [&](Node *root) {
        if (root) {
            int depth = 1;
            for (const auto &child: root->children) {
                depth = max(depth, 1 + dfs(child));
```

[429. N 叉树的层序遍历](https://leetcode.cn/problems/n-ary-tree-level-order-traversal/)

```
vector<vector<int>> levelOrder(Node *root) {
    vector<vector<int>> result;
    if (root) {
        queue<Node *> queue;
        queue.push(root);
        while (!queue.empty()) {
            vector<int> level;
            size_t size = queue.size();
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                Node *node = queue.front();
                queue.pop();
                level.emplace_back(node->val);
                for (const auto &child: node->children) {
                    queue.push(child);
                }
            }
            result.emplace_back(level);
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[427. 建立四叉树](https://leetcode.cn/problems/construct-quad-tree/)

```
Node *construct(vector<vector<int>> &grid) {
    const function<Node *(int, int, int, int)> dfs = [&](int y1, int y2, int x1, int x2) {
        for (int i = y1; i < y2; i++) {
            for (int j = x1; j < x2; j++) {
                if (grid[i][j] != grid[y1][x1]) {
                    return new Node(
                            true,
                            false,
                            dfs(y1, (y1 + y2) / 2, x1, (x1 + x2) / 2),     // top left
                            dfs(y1, (y1 + y2) / 2, (x1 + x2) / 2, x2),    // top right
                            dfs((y1 + y2) / 2, y2, x1, (x1 + x2) / 2),  // bottom left
                            dfs((y1 + y2) / 2, y2, (x1 + x2) / 2, x2)  // bottom right
                    );
                }
            }
        }
        return new Node(grid[y1][x1], true);
    };
    return dfs(0, grid.size(), 0, grid[0].size());
}
```

[558. 四叉树交集](https://leetcode.cn/problems/logical-or-of-two-binary-grids-represented-as-quad-trees/)

```
Node *intersect(Node *quadTree1, Node *quadTree2) {
    const function<Node *(Node *, Node *)> dfs = [&](Node *t1, Node *t2) {
        if (t1->isLeaf) {
            if (t1->val) {
                return new Node(true, true);
            } else {
                return new Node(t2->val, t2->isLeaf, t2->topLeft, t2->topRight, t2->bottomLeft, t2->bottomRight);
            }
        } else if (t2->isLeaf) {
            return intersect(t2, t1);
        } else {
            Node *n1 = intersect(t1->topLeft, t2->topLeft);
            Node *n2 = intersect(t1->topRight, t2->topRight);
            Node *n3 = intersect(t1->bottomLeft, t2->bottomLeft);
            Node *n4 = intersect(t1->bottomRight, t2->bottomRight);
            if (n1->isLeaf && n2->isLeaf && n3->isLeaf && n4->isLeaf && n1->val == n2->val && n1->val == n3->val && n1->val == n4->val) {
                return new Node(n1->val, true);
            } else {
                return new Node(false, false, n1, n2, n3, n4);
            }
        }
    };
    return dfs(quadTree1, quadTree2);
}
```

```
int reachableNodes(int n, vector<vector<int>> &edges, vector<int> &restricted) {
    vector<vector<int>> graph(n);
    for (const auto &edge: edges) {
        graph[edge[0]].emplace_back(edge[1]);
        graph[edge[1]].emplace_back(edge[0]);
    }

    vector<bool> visited(n);
    for (const auto &node: restricted) {
        visited[node] = true;
    }

    const function<int(int)> dfs = [&](int node) {
        visited[node] = true;
        int sum = 0;
        for (const auto &n: graph[node]) {
            if (!visited[n]) {
                sum += dfs(n);
            }
        }
        return 1 + sum;
    };
    return dfs(0);
}
```

```
vector<int> baseUnitConversions(vector<vector<int>> &conversions) {
    vector<vector<pair<long long, long long>>> graph(conversions.size() + 1);
    for (const auto &conversion: conversions) {
        graph[conversion[0]].emplace_back(conversion[1], conversion[2]);
    }

    vector<bool> visited(conversions.size() + 1);

    const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
    vector<int> result(conversions.size() + 1);
    const function<void(int, long long)> dfs = [&](int node, long long current) {
        visited[node] = true;
        result[node] = current;
        for (auto &[n, f]: graph[node]) {
            if (!visited[n]) {
                dfs(n, (current * f) % MOD);
            }
        }
    };
    dfs(0, 1LL);
    return result;
}
```

[3593. 使叶子路径成本相等的最小增量](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-increments-to-equalize-leaf-paths/)

```
int minIncrease(int n, vector<vector<int>> &edges, vector<int> &cost) {
    vector<vector<int>> graph(n);
    for (const auto &edge: edges) {
        graph[edge[0]].emplace_back(edge[1]);
        graph[edge[1]].emplace_back(edge[0]);
    }

    vector<bool> visited(n);

    int result = 0;
    const function<long long(int)> dfs = [&](int node) {
        visited[node] = true;

        vector<long long> counts;
        for (const auto &n: graph[node]) {
            if (!visited[n]) {
                counts.emplace_back(dfs(n));
            }
        }
        if (!counts.empty()) {
            long long m = *max_element(counts.begin(), counts.end());
            long long c = count(counts.begin(), counts.end(), m);
            result += counts.size() - c;
            return m + cost[node];
        } else {
            return static_cast<long long>(cost[node]);
        }
    };
    dfs(0);
    return result;
}
```

### 直径

[2246. 相邻字符不同的最长路径](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-path-with-different-adjacent-characters/)

```
int longestPath(vector<int> &parent, string s) {
    vector<vector<pair<int, char>>> graph(parent.size() + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < parent.size(); i++) {
        graph[parent[i]].emplace_back(i, s[i]);
        graph[i].emplace_back(parent[i], s[parent[i]]);
    }

    vector<bool> visited(parent.size() + 1);

    int result = 0;
    const function<int(int)> dfs = [&](int node) {
        visited[node] = true;
        vector<int> lengths;
        for (auto &[n, c]: graph[node]) {
            if (!visited[n]) {
                int length = dfs(n);
                if (s[n] != s[node]) {
                    lengths.emplace_back(length);
                }
            }
        }
        if (lengths.empty()) {
            result = max(result, 1);
            return 1;
        } else if (lengths.size() == 1) {
            result = max(result, lengths[0] + 1);
            return lengths[0] + 1;
        } else {
            sort(lengths.begin(), lengths.end());
            result = max(result, lengths[lengths.size() - 2] + lengths[lengths.size() - 1] + 1);
            return lengths[lengths.size() - 1] + 1;
        }
    };
    dfs(0);
    return result;
}
```

### 拓扑排序

[310. 最小高度树](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-height-trees/)

```
vector<int> findMinHeightTrees(int n, vector<vector<int>> &edges) {
    if (n == 1) {
        return {0};
    }
    
    vector<vector<int>> graph(n);
    for (const auto &edge: edges) {
        graph[edge[0]].emplace_back(edge[1]);
        graph[edge[1]].emplace_back(edge[0]);
    }

    vector<int> degree(n);
    for (const auto &edge: edges) {
        degree[edge[0]]++;
        degree[edge[1]]++;
    }

    queue<int> queue;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
        if (degree[i] == 1) {
            queue.push(i);
        }
    }
    int count = n;
    while (count > 2) {
        size_t size = queue.size();
        for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
            int node = queue.front();
            queue.pop();
            for (const auto &n: graph[node]) {
                degree[n]--;
                if (degree[n] == 1) {
                    queue.push(n);
                }
            }
        }
        count -= size;
    }

    vector<int> result;
    while (!queue.empty()) {
        result.emplace_back(queue.front());
        queue.pop();
    }
    return result;
}
```

## 字符串

### KMP算法

[28. 找出字符串中第一个匹配项的下标](https://leetcode.cn/problems/find-the-index-of-the-first-occurrence-in-a-string/)

```
int strStr(string haystack, string needle) {
    const auto bf = [&](string s, string p) {
        int m = s.size();
        int n = p.size();
        for (int i = 0; i <= m - n; i++) {
            if (s.substr(i, n) == p) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    };

    const auto kmp = [&](string s, string p) {
        int m = s.size();
        int n = p.size();

        vector<int> next(n, 0);
        for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < n; i++) {
            while (j > 0 && p[i] != p[j]) {
                j = next[j - 1];
            }
            if (p[i] == p[j]) {
                j++;
            }
            next[i] = j;
        }

        for (int i = 0, j = 0; i < m; i++) {
            while (j > 0 && s[i] != p[j]) {
                j = next[j - 1];
            }
            if (s[i] == p[j]) {
                j++;
            }
            if (j == n) {
                return i - n + 1;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    };

    const auto sunday = [&](string s, string p) {
        int m = s.size();
        int n = p.size();

        unordered_map<char, int> table;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            table[p[i]] = n - i;
        }

        int i = 0;
        while (i <= m - n) {
            if (s.substr(i, n) == p) {
                return i;
            }
            if (i < m - n) {
                i += table.contains(s[i + n]) ? table[s[i + n]] : n + 1;
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    };

    const auto sh = [&](string s, string p) {
        int m = s.size();
        int n = p.size();

        const unsigned long long base = 1337;
        vector<unsigned long long> hash(m + 1, 0);
        vector<unsigned long long> pow(m + 1, 1);
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            hash[i + 1] = hash[i] * base + s[i];
            pow[i + 1] = pow[i] * base;
        }

        unsigned long long target = 0;
        for (const auto &c: p) {
            target = target * base + c;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= m - n; i++) {
            if (hash[i + n] - hash[i] * pow[n] == target) {
                return i;
            }
        }
        return -1;
    };
    return kmp(haystack, needle);
}
```

```
string shortestPalindrome(string s) {
    string t = s + "#" + string(s.rbegin(), s.rend());
    vector<int> next(t.size(), 0);
    for (int i = 1, j = 0; i < t.size(); i++) {
        while (j > 0 && t[i] != t[j]) {
            j = next[j - 1];
        }
        if (t[i] == t[j]) {
            j++;
        }
        next[i] = j;
    }
    string right = s;
    string left(s.rbegin(), s.rend());
    return left.substr(0, left.size() - next.back()) + right;
}
```

### Z函数

对于一个长度为${n}$的字符串$s$，定义函数$𝑧[𝑖]$表示$𝑠$和$𝑠[𝑖,𝑛 −1]$（即以 𝑠[𝑖]开头的后缀）的最长公共前缀（LCP）的长度，则$𝑧$被称为$𝑠$的 **Z 函数**。特别地，$𝑧[0]=0$。

#### 朴素算法

```
vector<int> z(s.size());
for (int i = 1; i < s.size(); i++) {
    while (i + z[i] < s.size() && s[z[i]] == s[i + z[i]]) {
        ++z[i];
    };
}
```

#### 线性算法

```
vector<int> z(s.size());
for (int i = 1, l = 0, r = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
    if (i <= r && z[i - l] < r - i + 1) {
        z[i] = z[i - l];
    } else {
        z[i] = max(0, r - i + 1);
        while (i + z[i] < s.size() && s[z[i]] == s[i + z[i]]) {
            z[i]++;
        }
    }
    if (i + z[i] - 1 > r) {
        l = i;
        r = i + z[i] - 1;
    }
}
```

[2223. 构造字符串的总得分和](https://leetcode.cn/problems/sum-of-scores-of-built-strings/)

```
long long sumScores(string s) {
    vector<int> z(s.size());
    for (int i = 1, l = 0, r = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        if (i <= r && z[i - l] < r - i + 1) {
            z[i] = z[i - l];
        } else {
            z[i] = max(0, r - i + 1);
            while (i + z[i] < s.size() && s[z[i]] == s[i + z[i]]) {
                z[i]++;
            }
        }
        if (i + z[i] - 1 > r) {
            l = i;
            r = i + z[i] - 1;
        }
    }
    return accumulate(z.begin(), z.end(), 0LL) + z.size();
}
```

### Manacher算法

[5. 最长回文子串](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-palindromic-substring/)

```
string longestPalindrome(string s) {
    string t = "@";
    for (const auto &c: s) {
        t += "#";
        t += c;
    }
    t += "#!";

    vector<int> p(t.size());
    int mid = 0;
    int right = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < t.size(); i++) {
        int mirror = 2 * mid - i;
        if (i < right) {
            p[i] = min(right - i, p[mirror]);
        }
        while (t[i + p[i] + 1] == t[i - p[i] - 1]) {
            p[i]++;
        }
        if (i + p[i] > right) {
            mid = i;
            right = i + p[i];
        }
    }

    int index = 0;
    int length = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < t.size(); i++) {
        if (p[i] > length) {
            index = i;
            length = p[i];
        }
    }

    return s.substr((index - length) / 2, length);
}
```

```
string shortestPalindrome(string s) {

    for (const auto &c: s) {
        t += "#";
        t += c;
    }
    t += "#!";

    vector<int> p(t.size());
    int mid = 0;
    int right = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < t.size(); i++) {
        int mirror = 2 * mid - i;
        if (i < right) {
            p[i] = min(right - i, p[mirror]);
        }
        while (t[i + p[i] + 1] == t[i - p[i] - 1]) {
            p[i]++;
        }
        if (i + p[i] > right) {
            mid = i;
            right = i + p[i];
        }
    }

    int length = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < t.size(); ++i) {
        if (i - p[i] == 1) {
            length = max(length, p[i]);
        }
    }

    string r = s.substr(length);
    string l = r;
    reverse(l.begin(), l.end());
    return l + s.substr(0, length) + r;
}
```

### 中心拓展法

[5. 最长回文子串](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-palindromic-substring/)

```
string longestPalindrome(string s) {
    int start = 0;
    int length = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
            int l = i;
            int r = i + j;
            while (l >= 0 && r < s.size() && s[l] == s[r]) {
                l--;
                r++;
            }
            l++;
            r--;
            if (length < r - l + 1) {
                length = r - l + 1;
                start = l;
            }
        }
    }
    return s.substr(start, length);
}
```

[214. 最短回文串](https://leetcode.cn/problems/shortest-palindrome/)

```
string shortestPalindrome(string s) {
    int length = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 2; j++) {
            int l = i;
            int r = i + j;
            while (l >= 0 && r < s.size() && s[l] == s[r]) {
                l--;
                r++;
            }
            l++;
            r--;
            if (l == 0) {
                length = max(length, r - l + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    string right = s.substr(length);
    string left = right;
    reverse(left.begin(), left.end());
    return left + s.substr(0, length) + right;
}
```

### 字符串哈希

[2156. 查找给定哈希值的子串](https://leetcode.cn/problems/find-substring-with-given-hash-value/)

```
string subStrHash(string s, int power, int modulo, int k, int hashValue) {
    int m = s.size();
    unsigned long long hash = 0;
    unsigned long long pow = 1;
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        pow = pow * power % modulo;
    }

    const auto val = [](char c) {
        return c - 'a' + 1;
    };

    int index = -1;
    for (int i = m - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
        hash = (hash * power + val(s[i])) % modulo;
        if (i + k < m) {
            hash = (hash - val(s[i + k]) * pow % modulo + modulo) % modulo;
        }
        if (i + k <= m && hash == hashValue) {
            index = i;
        }
    }
    return s.substr(index, k);
}
```

[187. 重复的 DNA 序列](https://leetcode.cn/problems/repeated-dna-sequences/)

```
vector<string> findRepeatedDnaSequences(string s) {
    const unsigned long long base = 133337;
    vector<unsigned long long> hash(s.size() + 1, 0);
    vector<unsigned long long> pow(s.size() + 1, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
        hash[i + 1] = hash[i] * base + s[i];
        pow[i + 1] = pow[i] * base;
    }

    unordered_set<string> result;
    unordered_map<int, string> map;
    for (int i = 0; i <= static_cast<int>(s.size()) - 10; i++) {
        unsigned long long h = hash[i + 10] - hash[i] * pow[10];
        if (auto it = map.find(h);it != map.end()) {
            result.insert(it->second);
        } else {
            map[h] = s.substr(i, 10);
        }
    }
    return {result.begin(), result.end()};
}
```

```
vector<string> letterCombinations(string digits) {
    unordered_map<char, vector<string> > map = {
            {'2', {"a", "b", "c"}},
            {'3', {"d", "e", "f"}},
            {'4', {"g", "h", "i"}},
            {'5', {"j", "k", "l"}},
            {'6', {"m", "n", "o"}},
            {'7', {"p", "q", "r", "s"}},
            {'8', {"t", "u", "v"}},
            {'9', {"w", "x", "y", "z"}},
    };

    vector<string> result;
    int index = 0;
    const function<void(string)> backtrack = [&](string s) {
        if (index >= digits.size()) {
            result.emplace_back(s);
        }
        for (const auto &c: map[digits[index]]) {
            index++;
            backtrack(s + c);
            index--;
        }
    };
    backtrack("");
    return result;
}
```

```
        backtrack(index + 1);
        path.pop_back();

        backtrack(index + 1);

    backtrack(0);
```

```
int subsetXORSum(vector<int> &nums) {
    int result = 0;
    vector<int> path;
    const function<void(int, int)> backtrack = [&](int index, int sum) {
        if (index == nums.size()) {
            result += sum;
            return;
        }

        sum ^= nums[index];
        backtrack(index + 1, sum);
        sum ^= nums[index];

        backtrack(index + 1, sum);
    };
    backtrack(0, 0);
    return result;
}

int subsetXORSum(vector<int> &nums) {
    int result = 0;
    vector<int> path;
    const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int index) {
        result += accumulate(path.begin(), path.end(), 0, [](const auto &a, const auto &b) { return a ^ b; });
        for (int i = index; i < nums.size(); i++) {
            path.push_back(nums[i]);
            backtrack(i + 1);
            path.pop_back();
        }
    };
    backtrack(0);
    return result;
}
```

```
    const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int index) {

            result.emplace_back(path);

        }
    };
    backtrack(0);
    return result;
}
```

```
bool checkEqualPartitions(vector<int> &nums, long long target) {
    const function<bool(int, long long, long long)> backtrack = [&](int index, long long include, long long exclude) {
        if (include > target || exclude > target) {
            return false;
        }
        if (index == nums.size()) {
            return include == target && exclude == target;
        }
        return backtrack(index + 1, include * nums[index], exclude) || backtrack(index + 1, include, exclude * nums[index]);
    };
    return backtrack(0, 1, 1);
}
```

```
        if (index == nums.size()) {
            map[sum]++;
            return;
        }

        backtrack(index + 1, sum | nums[index]);

        backtrack(index + 1, sum);
    };
    backtrack(0, 0);
    return map.begin()->second;
}
```

```
int perfectMenu(vector<int> &materials, vector<vector<int>> &cookbooks, vector<vector<int>> &attribute, int limit) {
    int result = -1;
    int satiety = 0;
    int deliciousness = 0;
    const auto check = [&](int index) {
        for (int i = 0; i < cookbooks[index].size(); i++) {
            if (materials[i] < cookbooks[index][i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    };

    const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int index) {
        if (index == cookbooks.size()) {
            if (satiety >= limit) {
                result = max(result, deliciousness);
            }
            return;
        }
        if (check(index)) {
            for (int i = 0; i < cookbooks[index].size(); i++) {
                materials[i] -= cookbooks[index][i];
            }
            deliciousness += attribute[index][0];
            satiety += attribute[index][1];
            backtrack(index + 1);
            satiety -= attribute[index][1];
            deliciousness -= attribute[index][0];
            for (int i = 0; i < cookbooks[index].size(); i++) {
                materials[i] += cookbooks[index][i];
            }

            backtrack(index + 1);
        } else {
            backtrack(index + 1);
        }
    };
    backtrack(0);
    return result;
}
```

```
int maximumRows(vector<vector<int>> &matrix, int numSelect) {
    int result = 0;
    unordered_set<int> columns;

    const auto check = [&](unordered_set<int> &columns) {
        int count = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < matrix.size(); i++) {
            bool covered = true;
            for (int j = 0; j < matrix[i].size(); j++) {
                if (matrix[i][j] && !columns.contains(j)) {
                    covered = false;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (covered) {
                count++;
            }
        }
        return count;
    };

    const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int index) {
        if (index == matrix[0].size() || numSelect == 0) {
            result = max(result, check(columns));
            return;
        }

        numSelect--;
        columns.insert(index);
        backtrack(index + 1);
        columns.erase(index);
        numSelect++;

        backtrack(index + 1);
    };
    backtrack(0);
    return result;
}
```

```
int maxLength(vector<string> &arr) {
    int result = 0;
    unordered_set<char> set;
    const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int index) {
        if (index == arr.size()) {
            result = max(result, static_cast<int>(set.size()));
            return;
        }

        if (unordered_set<char>(arr[index].begin(), arr[index].end()).size() == arr[index].size()) {
            bool found = false;
            for (const auto &c: arr[index]) {
                if (set.contains(c)) {
                    found = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!found) {
                for (const auto &c: arr[index]) {
                    set.insert(c);
                }
                backtrack(index + 1);
                for (const auto &c: arr[index]) {
                    set.erase(c);
                }
            }
            backtrack(index + 1);
        } else {
            backtrack(index + 1);
        }
    };
    backtrack(0);
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<vector<string>> partition(string s) {
    vector<vector<string>> result;
    vector<string> path;

    const auto check = [&](string &s, int left, int right) {
        while (left < right) {
            if (s[left++] != s[right--]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    };

    const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int index) {
        if (index == s.size()) {
            result.emplace_back(path);
            return;
        }

        for (int i = index; i < s.size(); i++) {
            if (check(s, index, i)) {
                path.emplace_back(s.substr(index, i - index + 1));
                backtrack(i + 1);
                path.pop_back();
            }
        }
    };
    backtrack(0);
    return result;
}
```

```
int punishmentNumber(int n) {
    int result = 0;
    const function<bool(string &, int, int, int)> backtrack = [&](string &s, int index, int sum, int target) {
        if (index == s.size()) {
            return sum == target;
        }

        for (int i = index; i < s.size(); i++) {
            if (backtrack(s, i + 1, sum + stoi(s.substr(index, i - index + 1)), target)) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    };
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        string num = to_string(i * i);
        if (backtrack(num, 0, 0, i)) {
            result += i * i;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<string> restoreIpAddresses(string s) {
    vector<string> result;
    vector<string> path;
    const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int index) {
        if (index == s.size()) {
            if (path.size() == 4) {
                result.emplace_back(path[0] + "." + path[1] + "." + path[2] + "." + path[3]);
            }
            return;

        if (path.size() > 4) {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = index; i < s.size(); i++) {
            string t = s.substr(index, i - index + 1);
            if ((t.size() == 1 || t.front() != '0') && stoll(t) <= 255) {
                path.emplace_back(t);
                backtrack(i + 1);
                path.pop_back();
            }else{
                break;

        }
    };
    backtrack(0);
    return result;
```

```
class CombinationIterator {
private:
    set<string> strings;
    set<string>::iterator iterator;

public:
    CombinationIterator(string characters, int combinationLength) {
        string path;
        const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int index) {
            if (index == characters.size()) {
                if (path.size() == combinationLength) {
                    strings.insert(path);
                }
                return;
            }
            path.push_back(characters[index]);
            backtrack(index + 1);
            path.pop_back();

            backtrack(index + 1);
        };
        backtrack(0);
        iterator = strings.begin();
    }

    string next() {
        string result = *iterator;
        iterator++;
        return result;
    }

    bool hasNext() {
        return iterator != strings.end();
    }
};

            if (path.size() == combinationLength) {
                strings.insert(path);
                return;
            }
            for (int i = index; i < characters.size(); i++) {
                path.push_back(characters[i]);
                backtrack(i + 1);
                path.pop_back();
            }
        };
        backtrack(0);
        iterator = strings.begin();
    }

    string next() {
        string result = *iterator;
        iterator++;
        return result;
    }

    bool hasNext() {
        return iterator != strings.end();
    }
};
```

[22. 括号生成](https://leetcode.cn/problems/generate-parentheses/)

```
vector<string> generateParenthesis(int n) {
    vector<string> result;
    int left = 0;
    int right = 0;
    string path;
    const function<void(void)> backtrack = [&]() {
        if (path.size() == 2 * n) {
            result.emplace_back(path);
            return;
        }
        if (left < n) {
            path.push_back('(');
            left++;
            backtrack();
            left--;
            path.pop_back();
        }
        if (right < left) {
            path.push_back(')');
            right++;
            backtrack();
            right--;
            path.pop_back();
        }
    };
    backtrack();
    return result;
}
```

[3376. 破解锁的最少时间 I](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-time-to-break-locks-i/)

```
int findMinimumTime(vector<int> &strength, int k) {
    int result = INT_MAX;
    int time = 0;
    int x = 1;
    vector<bool> visited(strength.size());
    const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int count) {
        if (count == strength.size()) {
            result = min(result, time);
            return;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < strength.size(); i++) {
            int minutes = (strength[i] + x - 1) / x;
            if (!visited[i]) {
                visited[i] = true;
                time += minutes;
                x += k;
                backtrack(count + 1);
                x -= k;
                time -= minutes;
                visited[i] = false;
            }
        }
    };
    backtrack(0);
    return result;
}
```

[51. N 皇后](https://leetcode.cn/problems/n-queens/)

```
vector<vector<string> > solveNQueens(int n) {
    vector<vector<string> > result;
    vector<string> board;
    vector<int> queens(n, -1);
    unordered_set<int> columns;
    unordered_set<int> diagonals1;
    unordered_set<int> diagonals2;

    const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int i) {
        if (i == n) {
            vector<string> board(n, string(n, '.'));
            for (int index = 0; index < n; index++) {
                board[index][queens[index]] = 'Q';
            }
            result.emplace_back(board);
            return;
        }

        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (!columns.contains(j) && !diagonals1.contains(i + j) && !diagonals2.contains(i - j)) {
                queens[i] = j;
                columns.insert(j);
                diagonals1.insert(i + j);
                diagonals2.insert(i - j);
                backtrack(i + 1);
                diagonals2.erase(i - j);
                diagonals1.erase(i + j);
                columns.erase(j);
                queens[i] = -1;
            }
        }
    };
    backtrack(0);
    return result;
}
```

```
vector<vector<int>> subsetsWithDup(vector<int> &nums) {
    sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());
    vector<vector<int>> result;
    vector<int> path;
    const function<void(int)> backtrack = [&](int index) {
        result.emplace_back(path);
        for (int i = index; i < nums.size(); i++) {
            if (i == index || nums[i] != nums[i - 1]) {
                path.emplace_back(nums[i]);

        }
    };
    backtrack(0);
```

[40. 组合总和 II](https://leetcode.cn/problems/combination-sum-ii/)

```
vector<vector<int>> combinationSum2(vector<int> &candidates, int target) {
    sort(candidates.begin(), candidates.end());
    vector<vector<int>> result;
    vector<int> path;
    const function<void(int, int)> backtrack = [&](int index, int sum) {
        if (sum == target) {
            result.emplace_back(path);
            return;
        }
        if (sum > target) {
            return;
        }

        for (int i = index; i < candidates.size(); i++) {
            if (i == index || candidates[i] != candidates[i - 1]) {
                path.emplace_back(candidates[i]);
                backtrack(i + 1, sum + candidates[i]);
                path.pop_back();
            }
        }
    };
    backtrack(0, 0);
    return result;
}
```

```
        for (int i = index; i < nums.size(); i++) {
            if ((path.empty() || path.back() <= nums[i]) && !set.contains(nums[i])) {
                set.insert(nums[i]);
```

```
vector<int> numsSameConsecDiff(int n, int k) {
    vector<int> result;
    string path;
    const function<void(void)> backtrack = [&]() {
        if (path.size() == n) {
            result.emplace_back(stoi(path));
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            if ((path.empty() && i != 0) || (!path.empty() && abs((path.back() - '0') - i) == k)) {
```

[2094. 找出 3 位偶数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/finding-3-digit-even-numbers/)

```
vector<int> findEvenNumbers(vector<int> &digits) {
    sort(digits.begin(), digits.end());
    vector<int> result;
    int number = 0;
    int count = 0;
    vector<bool> visited(digits.size());
    const function<void(void)> backtrack = [&]() {
        if (count == 3) {
            result.emplace_back(number);
            return;
        }
        unordered_set<int> set;
        for (int i = 0; i < digits.size(); i++) {
            if (!visited[i]&&!set.contains(digits[i])) {
                if ((count == 0 && digits[i] != 0) || count == 1 || (count == 2 && digits[i] % 2 == 0)) {
                    set.insert(digits[i]);
                    visited[i] = true;
                    count++;
                    number = number * 10 + digits[i];
                    backtrack();
                    number /= 10;
                    count--;
                    visited[i] = false;
                }
            }
        }
    };
    backtrack();
    return result;
}
```

```
string getHappyString(int n, int k) {

    vector<string> result;

        if (path.size() == n) {
            result.emplace_back(path);

        }
        for (int i = 0; i < characters.size(); i++) {
            if (path.empty() || path.back() != characters[i]) {
```

```
int getMaximumGold(vector<vector<int>> &grid) {
    int result = 0;
    vector<vector<bool>> visited(grid.size(), vector<bool>(grid[0].size()));
    const function<int(int, int)> backtrack = [&](int i, int j) {
        visited[i][j] = true;
        int maximum = 0;
        vector<pair<int, int> > directions = {{-1, 0}, {1,  0}, {0,  -1}, {0,  1}};
        for (auto &[dx, dy]: directions) {
            int x = i + dx;
            int y = j + dy;
            if (x >= 0 && x < grid.size() && y >= 0 && y < grid[x].size() && grid[x][y] && !visited[x][y]) {
                maximum = max(maximum, backtrack(x, y));
            }
        }
        visited[i][j] = false;
        return grid[i][j] + maximum;
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < grid[i].size(); j++) {
            if (grid[i][j]) {
                result = max(result, backtrack(i, j));
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[79. 单词搜索](https://leetcode.cn/problems/word-search/)

```
bool exist(vector<vector<char>> &board, string word) {
    int index = 0;
    vector<vector<bool>> visited(board.size(), vector<bool>(board[0].size()));
    const function<bool(int, int)> backtrack = [&](int i, int j) {
        index++;
        visited[i][j] = true;
        if (index == word.size()) {
            return true;
        }
        vector<pair<int, int> > directions = {{-1, 0}, {1,  0}, {0,  -1}, {0,  1}};
        for (auto &[dx, dy]: directions) {
            int x = i + dx;
            int y = j + dy;
            if (x >= 0 && x < board.size() && y >= 0 && y < board[x].size() && !visited[x][y] &&
                index < word.size() && board[x][y] == word[index]) {
                if (backtrack(x, y)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
        visited[i][j] = false;
        index--;
        return false;
    };

    for (int i = 0; i < board.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < board[i].size(); j++) {
            if (board[i][j] == word.front()) {
                if (backtrack(i, j)) {
                    return true;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return false;
}
```

```
vector<vector<int>> specialGrid(int n) {
    vector<vector<int>> result(1 << n, vector<int>(1 << n));
    int value = 0;
    const function<void(int, int, int, int)> backtrack = [&](int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2) {
        if (x2 - x1 == 1) {
            result[x1][y1] = value++;
            return;
        }
        int mid = (x2 - x1) / 2;
        backtrack(x1, y1 + mid, x1 + mid, y2);
        backtrack(x1 + mid, y1 + mid, x2, y2);
        backtrack(x1 + mid, y1, x2, y1 + mid);
        backtrack(x1, y1, x1 + mid, y1 + mid);
    };
    backtrack(0, 0, 1 << n, 1 << n);
    return result;
}
```
