[3393. 统计异或值为给定值的路径数目](https://leetcode.cn/problems/count-paths-with-the-given-xor-value/)

```
int countPathsWithXorValue(vector<vector<int>> &grid, int k) {
    const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
    int maximum = INT_MIN;
    for (int i = 0; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < grid[i].size(); j++) {
            maximum = max(maximum, grid[i][j]);
        }
    }
    maximum = (1 << bit_width(static_cast<unsigned int>(maximum)));
    if (maximum <= k) {
        return 0;
    }
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(grid.size(), vector<vector<int>>(grid.front().size(), vector<int>(maximum)));
    for (int i = 0; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < grid[i].size(); j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < maximum; k++) {
                if (i && j) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = (dp[i - 1][j][grid[i][j] ^ k] + dp[i][j - 1][grid[i][j] ^ k]) % MOD;
                } else if (i) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = dp[i - 1][j][grid[i][j] ^ k];
                } else if (j) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = dp[i][j - 1][grid[i][j] ^ k];
                } else {
                    dp[i][j][grid[i][j]] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back()[k];
}
```

[931. 下降路径最小和](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-falling-path-sum/)

```
int minFallingPathSum(vector<vector<int>> &matrix) {
    vector<vector<int>> dp(matrix.size(), vector<int>(matrix.front().size(), 0));
    for (int j = 0; j < matrix.front().size(); j++) {
        dp[0][j] = matrix[0][j];
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < matrix.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < matrix[i].size(); j++) {
            if (i > 0) {
                if (j == 0) {
                    dp[i][j] = matrix[i][j] + min(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i - 1][j + 1]);
                } else if (j == matrix[i].size() - 1) {
                    dp[i][j] = matrix[i][j] + min(dp[i - 1][j - 1], dp[i - 1][j]);
                } else {
                    dp[i][j] = matrix[i][j] + min({dp[i - 1][j - 1], dp[i - 1][j], dp[i - 1][j + 1]});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    return *min_element(dp.back().begin(), dp.back().end());
}
```

[2684. 矩阵中移动的最大次数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-number-of-moves-in-a-grid/)

```
int maxMoves(vector<vector<int>> &matrix) {
    int result = 0;
    vector<vector<int>> dp(matrix.size(), vector<int>(matrix.front().size(), -1));
    for (int i = 0; i < matrix.size(); i++) {
        dp[i][0] = 0;
    }
    for (int j = 1; j < matrix.front().size(); j++) {
        for (int i = 0; i < matrix.size(); i++) {
            const static vector<pair<int, int>> directions = {
                    {-1, -1},
                    {0,  -1},
                    {1,  -1}};
            for (const auto &[dx, dy]: directions) {
                int x = i + dx;
                int y = j + dy;
                if (x >= 0 && x < matrix.size() && y >= 0 &&
                    y < matrix[x].size()) {
                    if (matrix[i][j] > matrix[x][y] && dp[x][y] != -1) {
                        dp[i][j] = max(dp[i][j], dp[x][y] + 1);
                    }
                }
            }
            result = max(result, dp[i][j]);
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[3603. 交替方向的最小路径代价 II](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-cost-path-with-alternating-directions-ii/)

```
long long minCost(int m, int n, vector<vector<int>> &waitCost) {
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(m, vector<long long>(n));
    for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
            if (i && j) {
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i - 1][j] + waitCost[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1] + waitCost[i][j - 1]) + (i + 1) * (j + 1);
            } else if (i) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] + waitCost[i - 1][j] + i + 1;
            } else if (j) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i][j - 1] + waitCost[i][j - 1] + j + 1;
            } else {
                dp[0][0] = 1;
                waitCost[0][0] = 0;
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back();
}
```

[2304. 网格中的最小路径代价](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-path-cost-in-a-grid/)

```
int minPathCost(vector<vector<int>> &grid, vector<vector<int>> &moveCost) {
    vector<vector<int>> dp(grid.size(), vector<int>(grid.front().size()));
    for (int i = 0; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < grid[i].size(); j++) {
            if (i && j) {
                int minimum = INT_MAX;
                for (int k = 0; k < grid[i - 1].size(); k++) {
                    minimum = min(minimum, dp[i - 1][k] + moveCost[grid[i - 1][k]][j]);
                }
                dp[i][j] = minimum + grid[i][j];
            } else if (i) {
                int minimum = INT_MAX;
                for (int k = 0; k < grid[i - 1].size(); k++) {
                    minimum = min(minimum, dp[i - 1][k] + moveCost[grid[i - 1][k]][j]);
                }
                dp[i][j] = minimum + grid[i][j];
            } else if (j) {
                dp[i][j] = grid[i][j];
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = grid[i][j];
            }
        }
    }
    return *min_element(dp.back().begin(), dp.back().end());
}
```

[1289. 下降路径最小和 II](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-falling-path-sum-ii/)

int minFallingPathSum(vector<vector<int>> &grid) {
    vector<vector<int>> dp(grid.size(), vector<int>(grid.front().size(), 0));
    for (int i = 0; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < grid[i].size(); j++) {
            if (i != 0) {
                int minimum = INT_MAX;
                for (int k = 0; k < grid[i].size(); k++) {
                    if (k != j) {
                        minimum = min(minimum, dp[i - 1][k]);
                    }
                }
                dp[i][j] = grid[i][j] + minimum;
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = grid[i][j];
            }
        }
    }
    return *min_element(dp.back().begin(), dp.back().end());
}

[3418. 机器人可以获得的最大金币数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-amount-of-money-robot-can-earn/)

```
int maximumAmount(vector<vector<int>> &coins) {
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(coins.size(),
                                   vector<vector<int>>(coins.front().size(), vector<int>(2 + 1, INT_MIN / 2)));
    dp[0][0][0] = coins[0][0];
    dp[0][0][1] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < coins.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < coins[i].size(); j++) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
                if (i > 0) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = max(dp[i][j][k], dp[i - 1][j][k] + coins[i][j]);
                }
                if (j > 0) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = max(dp[i][j][k], dp[i][j - 1][k] + coins[i][j]);
                }
            }
            for (int k = 1; k < 3; k++) {
                if (i > 0) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = max(dp[i][j][k], dp[i - 1][j][k - 1]);
                }
                if (j > 0) {
                    dp[i][j][k] = max(dp[i][j][k], dp[i][j - 1][k - 1]);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return *max_element(dp.back().back().begin(), dp.back().back().end());
}

[3742. 网格中得分最大的路径](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-path-score-in-a-grid/)

```
int maxPathScore(vector<vector<int>> &grid, int k) {
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(grid.size(), vector<vector<int>>(grid.front().size(), vector<int>(k + 1, INT_MIN)));
    dp[0][0][0] = grid[0][0];
    for (int i = 0; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < grid[i].size(); j++) {
            for (int c = 0; c <= k; c++) {
                int cost = grid[i][j] ? 1 : 0;
                if (c >= cost) {
                    if (i > 0) {
                        dp[i][j][c] = max(dp[i][j][c], dp[i - 1][j][c - cost] + grid[i][j]);
                    }
                    if (j > 0) {
                        dp[i][j][c] = max(dp[i][j][c], dp[i][j - 1][c - cost] + grid[i][j]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    int result = *max_element(dp.back().back().begin(), dp.back().back().end());
    return result < 0 ? -1 : result;
}
```

[1594. 矩阵的最大非负积](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-non-negative-product-in-a-matrix/)

```
int maxProductPath(vector<vector<int>> &grid) {
    const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dp(grid.size(), vector<vector<long long>>(grid.front().size(), vector<long long>(2)));
    dp[0][0][0] = dp[0][0][1] = grid[0][0];
    for (int i = 1; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        dp[i][0][0] = dp[i][0][1] = dp[i - 1][0][0] * grid[i][0];
    }
    for (int j = 1; j < grid.front().size(); j++) {
        dp[0][j][0] = dp[0][j][1] = dp[0][j - 1][0] * grid[0][j];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < grid.front().size(); j++) {
            long long a = dp[i - 1][j][0] * grid[i][j];
            long long b = dp[i - 1][j][1] * grid[i][j];
            long long c = dp[i][j - 1][0] * grid[i][j];
            long long d = dp[i][j - 1][1] * grid[i][j];
            dp[i][j][0] = max({a, b, c, d});
            dp[i][j][1] = min({a, b, c, d});
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back().front() < 0 ? -1 : dp.back().back().front() % MOD;
}
```

### 背包问题

#### 0-1背包

- 求最优的状态转移方程：$dp[i][j]=max(dp[i-1][j],dp[i-1][j-weight[i]]+value[i]),dp[0][0]=0$
- 求数量的状态转移方程：$dp[i][j]=max(dp[i-1][j],dp[i-1][j-weight[i]]+1),dp[0][0]=0$
- 求方案的状态转移方程：$dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j]+dp[i-1][j-nums[i]],dp[0][0]=1$
- 求可行性的状态转移方程：$dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j]||dp[i-1][j-nums[i]],dp[0][0]=true$

[416. 分割等和子集](https://leetcode.cn/problems/partition-equal-subset-sum/)

```
bool canPartition(vector<int> &nums) {
    int sum = accumulate(nums.begin(), nums.end(), 0);
    if (sum % 2 == 1) {
        return false;
    }
    vector<vector<int>> dp(nums.size() + 1, vector<int>(sum / 2 + 1, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= nums.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= sum / 2; j++) {
            if (j < nums[i - 1]) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j];
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i - 1][j - nums[i - 1]] + nums[i - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back() == sum / 2;
}
```

[494. 目标和](https://leetcode.cn/problems/target-sum/)

```
int findTargetSumWays(vector<int> &nums, int target) {
    int sum = accumulate(nums.begin(), nums.end(), 0);
    target += sum;
    if (target < 0 || target % 2 == 1) {
        return 0;
    }
    target /= 2;
    vector<vector<int>> dp(nums.size() + 1, vector<int>(target + 1, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= nums.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= target; j++) {
            if (j < nums[i - 1]) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j];
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] + dp[i - 1][j - nums[i - 1]];
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back();
}
```

[2915. 和为目标值的最长子序列的长度](https://leetcode.cn/problems/length-of-the-longest-subsequence-that-sums-to-target/)

            if (j < nums[i - 1]) {

            } else {

}

[2787. 将一个数字表示成幂的和的方案数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/ways-to-express-an-integer-as-sum-of-powers/)

```
int numberOfWays(int n, int x) {
    vector<int> power;
    for (int i = 1; pow(i, x) <= n; i++) {
        power.push_back(pow(i, x));
    }
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(power.size() + 1, vector<long long>(n + 1, 0));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    for (long long i = 1; i <= power.size(); i++) {
        for (long long j = 0; j <= n; j++) {
            if (j < power[i - 1]) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j];
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j] + dp[i - 1][j - power[i - 1]];
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back() % static_cast<int>(1e9 + 7);
}
```

#### 完全背包

- 求最优的状态转移方程：$dp[i][j]=max(dp[i-1][j],dp[i][j-weight[i]]+value[i]),dp[0][0]=0$
- 求数量的状态转移方程：$dp[i][j]=max(dp[i-1][j],dp[i][j-weight[i]]+1),dp[0][0]=0$
- 求方案的状态转移方程：$dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j]+dp[i][j-nums[i]],dp[0][0]=1$
- 求可行性的状态转移方程：$dp[i][j]=dp[i-1][j]||dp[i][j-nums[i]],dp[0][0]=true$

[322. 零钱兑换](https://leetcode.cn/problems/coin-change/)

```
int coinChange(vector<int> &coins, int amount) {
    vector<vector<int> > dp(coins.size() + 1, vector<int>(amount + 1, INT_MAX / 2));
    dp[0][0] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i <= coins.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j <= amount; j++) {
            if (j < coins[i - 1]) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j];
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = min(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - coins[i - 1]] + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back() != INT_MAX / 2 ? dp.back().back() : -1;
}

### 最长公共子序列（LCS）

- $dp[i][j]$表示$s_1[0:i]$和$s_2[0:j]$的最长公共子序列的长度
- 状态转移方程：$dp[i][j]=\begin{cases} dp[i-1][j-1]+1 & s_1[i-1]=s_2[j-1]\\ max(dp[i-1][j],dp[i][j-1])&s_1[i-1]\neq s_2[j-1]\end{cases}$
- 特别地，对于编辑距离问题，$dp[i-1][j-1]$表示替换操作，$dp[i-1][j]$表示删除操作，$dp[i][j-1]$表示插入操作

[1143. 最长公共子序列](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-common-subsequence/)

```
int longestCommonSubsequence(string text1, string text2) {
    vector<vector<int>> dp(text1.size() + 1, vector<int>(text2.size() + 1));
    for (int i = 1; i <= text1.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= text2.size(); j++) {
            if (text1[i - 1] == text2[j - 1]) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back();
}
```

[583. 两个字符串的删除操作](https://leetcode.cn/problems/delete-operation-for-two-strings/)

```
int minDistance(string word1, string word2) {
    vector<vector<int>> dp(word1.size() + 1, vector<int>(word2.size() + 1));
    for (int i = 1; i <= word1.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= word2.size(); j++) {
            if (word1[i - 1] == word2[j - 1]) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + 1;
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
            }
        }
    }
    return word1.size() - dp.back().back() + word2.size() - dp.back().back();
}

int minimumDeleteSum(string s1, string s2) {

    for (int i = 1; i <= s1.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= s2.size(); j++) {
            if (s1[i - 1] == s2[j - 1]) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1] + s1[i - 1];
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = max(dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1]);
            }
        }

           dp.back().back();
}

int minDistance(string word1, string word2) {
    if (word1.size() * word2.size() == 0) {
        return word1.size() + word2.size();
    }
    vector<vector<int>> dp(word1.size() + 1, vector<int>(word2.size() + 1));
    for (int i = 0; i < word1.size() + 1; i++) {
        dp[i][0] = i;
    }
    for (int j = 0; j < word2.size() + 1; j++) {
        dp[0][j] = j;
    }
    for (int i = 1; i <= word1.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j <= word2.size(); j++) {
            if (word1[i - 1] == word2[j - 1]) {
                dp[i][j] = dp[i - 1][j - 1];
            } else {
                dp[i][j] = min({dp[i - 1][j], dp[i][j - 1], dp[i - 1][j - 1]}) + 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back();
}

### 最长递增子序列（LIS）

状态转移方程：$dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1)$状态转移方程：$dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1)$

[300. 最长递增子序列](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-increasing-subsequence/)

```
int lengthOfLIS(vector<int> &nums) {
    vector<int> dp(nums.size(), 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            if (nums[i] > nums[j]) {
                dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    return *max_element(dp.begin(), dp.end());
}

```
bool increasingTriplet(vector<int> &nums) {
    int first = INT_MAX;
    int second = INT_MAX;
    for (int num: nums) {
        if (num <= first) {
            first = num;
        } else if (num <= second) {
            second = num;
        } else {
            return true;  // num > second > first
        }
    }
    return false;
}
```

            if (nums[i] >= nums[j]) {
                dp[i] = max(dp[i], dp[j] + 1);
            }
        }
    }
    return nums.size() - *max_element(dp.begin(), dp.end());
}

### 划分型DP

#### 能否划分

[2369. 检查数组是否存在有效划分](https://leetcode.cn/problems/check-if-there-is-a-valid-partition-for-the-array/)

```
bool validPartition(vector<int> &nums) {
    vector<bool> dp(nums.size() + 1);
    dp[0] = true;
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        if (dp[i - 1] && nums[i] == nums[i - 1] ||
            i > 1 && dp[i - 2] && nums[i] == nums[i - 1] && nums[i] == nums[i - 2] ||
            i > 1 && dp[i - 2] && nums[i] == nums[i - 1] + 1 && nums[i] == nums[i - 2] + 2) {
            dp[i + 1] = true;
        }
    }
    return dp.back();
}
```

[139. 单词拆分](https://leetcode.cn/problems/word-break/)

```
bool wordBreak(string s, vector<string> &wordDict) {
    unordered_set<string> set(wordDict.begin(), wordDict.end());
    vector<bool> dp(s.size() + 1);
    dp[0] = true;
    for (int i = 1; i < s.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            if (dp[j] && set.contains(s.substr(j, i - j))) {
                dp[i] = true;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back();
}
```

### 状态机DP

#### 买卖股票

[121. 买卖股票的最佳时机](https://leetcode.cn/problems/best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock/)

```
int maxProfit(vector<int> &prices) {
    int minimum = INT_MAX;
    vector<int> dp(prices.size() + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i <= prices.size(); i++) {
        dp[i] = max(dp[i - 1], prices[i - 1] - minimum);
        minimum = min(minimum, prices[i - 1]);
    }
    return dp.back();
}

[122. 买卖股票的最佳时机 II](https://leetcode.cn/problems/best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock-ii/)

```
int maxProfit(vector<int> &prices) {
    // dp[0][0] = -prices[0]     第0天买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][1] = 0              第0天卖出后的最大利润
    vector<vector<int>> dp(prices.size(), vector<int>(2));
    dp[0][0] = -prices[0];
    dp[0][1] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < prices.size(); i++) {
        dp[i][0] = max(dp[i - 1][0], dp[i - 1][1] - prices[i]);
        dp[i][1] = max(dp[i - 1][1], dp[i - 1][0] + prices[i]);
    }
    return dp.back().back();
}
```

[123. 买卖股票的最佳时机 III](https://leetcode.cn/problems/best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock-iii/)

```
int maxProfit(vector<int> &prices) {
    // dp[0][0][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第0次交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][1] = 0              第0天第0次交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][1][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第1次交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][1][1] = 0              第0天第1次交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][2][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第2次交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][2][1] = 0              第0天第2次交易卖出后的最大利润
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(prices.size(), vector<vector<int>>(3, vector<int>(2)));
    dp[0][0][0] = -prices[0];
    dp[0][0][1] = 0;
    dp[0][1][0] = -prices[0];
    dp[0][1][1] = 0;
    dp[0][2][0] = -prices[0];
    dp[0][1][1] = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < dp.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < dp[i].size(); j++) {
            dp[i][j][0] = max(dp[i - 1][j][0], dp[i - 1][j][1] - prices[i]);
            if (j > 0) {
                dp[i][j][1] = max(dp[i - 1][j][1], dp[i - 1][j - 1][0] + prices[i]);
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back().back();
}

```
int maxProfit(int k, vector<int> &prices) {
    // dp[0][0][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第0次交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][1] = 0              第0天第0次交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][1][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第1次交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][1][1] = 0              第0天第1次交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][2][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第2次交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][2][1] = 0              第0天第2次交易卖出后的最大利润
    // ...
    // dp[0][k][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第k次交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][k][1] = 0              第0天第k次交易卖出后的最大利润
    vector<vector<vector<int>>> dp(prices.size(), vector<vector<int>>(k + 1, vector<int>(2)));
    for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
        dp[0][i][0] = -prices[0];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < dp.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < dp[i].size(); j++) {
            dp[i][j][0] = max(dp[i - 1][j][0], dp[i - 1][j][1] - prices[i]);
            if (j > 0) {
                dp[i][j][1] = max(dp[i - 1][j][1], dp[i - 1][j - 1][0] + prices[i]);
            }
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back().back();
}

[3573. 买卖股票的最佳时机 V](https://leetcode.cn/problems/best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock-v/)

```
long long maximumProfit(vector<int> &prices, int k) {
    // dp[0][0][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第0次普通交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][1] = 0              第0天第0次普通交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][2] = prices[0]      第0天第0次做空交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][3] = 0              第0天第0次做空交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][1][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第1次普通交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][1][1] = 0              第0天第1次普通交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][2] = prices[0]      第0天第1次做空交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][3] = 0              第0天第1次做空交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][2][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第2次普通交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][2][1] = 0              第0天第2次普通交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][2] = prices[0]      第0天第2次做空交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][3] = 0              第0天第2次做空交易买入后的最大利润
    // ...
    // dp[0][k][0] = -prices[0]     第0天第k次普通交易买入后的最大利润
    // dp[0][k][1] = 0              第0天第k次普通交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][2] = prices[0]      第0天第k次做空交易卖出后的最大利润
    // dp[0][0][3] = 0              第0天第k次做空交易买入后的最大利润
    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dp(prices.size(), vector<vector<long long>>(k + 1, vector<long long>(4)));
    for (int i = 0; i <= k; i++) {
        dp[0][i][0] = -prices[0];
        dp[0][i][2] = prices[0];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < dp.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < dp[i].size(); j++) {
            dp[i][j][0] = max({dp[i - 1][j][0], dp[i - 1][j][1] - prices[i], dp[i - 1][j][3] - prices[i]});
            if (j > 0) {
                dp[i][j][1] = max({dp[i - 1][j][1], dp[i - 1][j - 1][0] + prices[i]});
            }
            dp[i][j][2] = max({dp[i - 1][j][2], dp[i - 1][j][1] + prices[i], dp[i - 1][j][3] + prices[i]});
            if (j > 0) {
                dp[i][j][3] = max({dp[i - 1][j][3], dp[i - 1][j - 1][2] - prices[i]});
            }
        }
    }
    return max(dp.back().back()[1], dp.back().back()[3]);
}
```

[309. 买卖股票的最佳时机含冷冻期](https://leetcode.cn/problems/best-time-to-buy-and-sell-stock-with-cooldown/)

```
int maxProfit(vector<int> &prices) {
    if (prices.size() == 1) {
        return 0;
    } else if (prices.size() == 2) {
        return max(0, prices.back() - prices.front());
    } else {
        // dp[0][0] = -prices[0]     第0天买入后的最大利润
        // dp[0][1] = 0              第0天卖出后的最大利润
        vector<vector<int>> dp(prices.size(), vector<int>(2));
        dp[0][0] = -prices[0];
        dp[0][1] = 0;
        dp[1][0] = max(dp[1 - 1][0], -prices[1]);
        dp[1][1] = max(dp[1 - 1][1], dp[1 - 1][0] + prices[1]);
        for (int i = 1; i < prices.size(); i++) {
            dp[i][0] = max(dp[i - 1][0], dp[i - 2][1] - prices[i]);
            dp[i][1] = max(dp[i - 1][1], dp[i - 1][0] + prices[i]);
        }
        return dp.back().back();
    }
}
```

    // dp[0][1] = 0              第0天卖出后的最大利润

    }
    return dp.back().back();
}

[2222. 选择建筑的方案数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/number-of-ways-to-select-buildings/)

```
long long numberOfWays(string s) {
    // dp[0][0] 表示s.substr(0,i)中值为"0"的子序列的数量
    // dp[0][1] 表示s.substr(0,i)中值为"1"的子序列的数量
    // dp[0][2] 表示s.substr(0,i)中值为"01"的子序列的数量
    // dp[0][3] 表示s.substr(0,i)中值为"10"的子序列的数量
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(s.size(), vector<long long>(4));
    dp[0][0] = s.front() == '0' ? 1 : 0;
    dp[0][1] = s.front() == '1' ? 1 : 0;
    long long result = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < dp.size(); i++) {
        if (s[i] == '0') {
            dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0] + 1;
            dp[i][1] = dp[i - 1][1];
            dp[i][2] = dp[i - 1][2];
            dp[i][3] = dp[i - 1][3] + dp[i - 1][1];
            result += dp[i][2];
        } else {
            dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0];
            dp[i][1] = dp[i - 1][1] + 1;
            dp[i][2] = dp[i - 1][2] + dp[i - 1][0];
            dp[i][3] = dp[i - 1][3];
            result += dp[i][3];
        }
    }
    return result;
}

[1567. 乘积为正数的最长子数组长度](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-length-of-subarray-with-positive-product/)

int getMaxLen(vector<int> &nums) {
    vector<vector<int>> dp(nums.size(), vector<int>(2));
    dp[0][0] = nums[0] > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    dp[0][1] = nums[0] < 0 ? 1 : 0;
    int result = dp[0][0];
    for (int i = 1; i < dp.size(); i++) {
        if (nums[i] > 0) {
            dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0] + 1;
            dp[i][1] = dp[i - 1][1] > 0 ? dp[i - 1][1] + 1 : 0;
        } else if (nums[i] < 0) {
            dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][1] > 0 ? dp[i - 1][1] + 1 : 0;
            dp[i][1] = dp[i - 1][0] + 1;
        } else {
            dp[i][0] = 0;
            dp[i][1] = 0;
        }
        result = max(result, dp[i][0]);
    }
    return result;
}

[2786. 访问数组中的位置使分数最大](https://leetcode.cn/problems/visit-array-positions-to-maximize-score/)

```
long long maxScore(vector<int> &nums, int x) {
    // dp[0][0] 表示当前位置为0时之前选的是偶数的最大和
    // dp[0][1] 表示当前位置为0时之前选的是奇数的最大和
    vector<vector<long long>> dp(nums.size(), vector<long long>(2));
    dp[0][0] = nums[0] % 2 == 0 ? nums[0] : nums[0] - x;
    dp[0][1] = nums[0] % 2 == 1 ? nums[0] : nums[0] - x;
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        if (nums[i] % 2) {
            dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0];
            dp[i][1] = max(dp[i - 1][0] + nums[i] - x, dp[i - 1][1] + nums[i]);
        } else {
            dp[i][0] = max(dp[i - 1][0] + nums[i], dp[i - 1][1] + nums[i] - x);
            dp[i][1] = dp[i - 1][1];
        }
    }
    return *max_element(dp.back().begin(), dp.back().end());
}
```

[376. 摆动序列](https://leetcode.cn/problems/wiggle-subsequence/)

```
int wiggleMaxLength(vector<int> &nums) {
    if (nums.size() <= 1) {
        return nums.size();
    }
    // dp[i][0] 表示当前位置为i时，最后为上摆时的子序列最长长度
    // dp[i][1] 表示当前位置为i时，最后为下摆时的子序列最长长度
    vector<vector<int>> dp(nums.size(), vector<int>(2));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    dp[0][1] = 1;
    int result = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < i; j++) {
            if (nums[i] > nums[j]) {
                dp[i][0] = max(dp[i][0], dp[j][1] + 1);
            } else if (nums[i] < nums[j]) {
                dp[i][1] = max(dp[i][1], dp[j][0] + 1);
            }
        }
        result = max({result, dp[i][0], dp[i][1]});
    }
    return result;
}
```

[2771. 构造最长非递减子数组](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-non-decreasing-subarray-from-two-arrays/)

```
int maxNonDecreasingLength(vector<int> &nums1, vector<int> &nums2) {
    // dp[i][0] 第i个数是从nums1中选择时最长非递减子数组的最大长度
    // dp[i][1] 第i个数是从nums2中选择时最长非递减子数组的最大长度
    vector<vector<int>> dp(nums1.size(), vector<int>(2, 1));
    dp[0][0] = 1;
    dp[0][1] = 1;
    int result = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < nums1.size(); i++) {
        if (nums1[i] >= nums1[i - 1]) {
            dp[i][0] = max(dp[i][0], dp[i - 1][0] + 1);
        }
        if (nums1[i] >= nums2[i - 1]) {
            dp[i][0] = max(dp[i][0], dp[i - 1][1] + 1);
        }
        if (nums2[i] >= nums1[i - 1]) {
            dp[i][1] = max(dp[i][1], dp[i - 1][0] + 1);
        }
        if (nums2[i] >= nums2[i - 1]) {
            dp[i][1] = max(dp[i][1], dp[i - 1][1] + 1);
        }
        result = max({result, dp[i][0], dp[i][1]});
    }
    return result;
}

[1594. 矩阵的最大非负积](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-non-negative-product-in-a-matrix/)

```
int maxProductPath(vector<vector<int>> &grid) {
    const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> dp(grid.size(), vector<vector<long long>>(grid.front().size(), vector<long long>(2)));
    dp[0][0][0] = dp[0][0][1] = grid[0][0];
    for (int i = 1; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        dp[i][0][0] = dp[i][0][1] = dp[i - 1][0][0] * grid[i][0];
    }
    for (int j = 1; j < grid.front().size(); j++) {
        dp[0][j][0] = dp[0][j][1] = dp[0][j - 1][0] * grid[0][j];
    }
    for (int i = 1; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 1; j < grid.front().size(); j++) {
            long long a = dp[i - 1][j][0] * grid[i][j];
            long long b = dp[i - 1][j][1] * grid[i][j];
            long long c = dp[i][j - 1][0] * grid[i][j];
            long long d = dp[i][j - 1][1] * grid[i][j];
            dp[i][j][0] = max({a, b, c, d});
            dp[i][j][1] = min({a, b, c, d});
        }
    }
    return dp.back().back().front() < 0 ? -1 : dp.back().back().front() % MOD;
}
```

[3738. 替换至多一个元素后最长非递减子数组](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-non-decreasing-subarray-after-replacing-at-most-one-element/)

```
int longestSubarray(vector<int> &nums) {
    // dp[i][0] 表示i位置之前还未替换;
    // dp[i][1] 表示i位置之前已经替换;
    vector<vector<int>> dp(nums.size(), vector<int>(2, 1));
    int result = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        if (nums[i] >= nums[i - 1]) {
            dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0] + 1;
            dp[i][1] = dp[i - 1][1] + 1;
        }
        if (i >= 2 && nums[i] >= nums[i - 2]) {
            dp[i][1] = max(dp[i][1], dp[i - 2][0] + 2);
        } else {
            dp[i][1] = max(dp[i][1], 2);
        }
        result = max({result, dp[i - 1][0] + 1, dp[i][1]});
    }
    return result;
}
```

## 贪心算法

### 贪心策略

#### 从最小/最大开始贪心

[3074. 重新分装苹果](https://leetcode.cn/problems/apple-redistribution-into-boxes/)

```
int minimumBoxes(vector<int> &apple, vector<int> &capacity) {
    int sum = accumulate(apple.begin(), apple.end(), 0);
    sort(capacity.rbegin(), capacity.rend());
    int result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < capacity.size() && sum > 0; i++) {
        sum -= capacity[i];
        result++;
    }
    return result;
}
```

[3545. 不同字符数量最多为 K 时的最少删除数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-deletions-for-at-most-k-distinct-characters/)

```
int minDeletion(string s, int k) {
    unordered_map<char, int> map;
    for (const auto &c: s) {
        map[c]++;
    }

    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<>> pq;
    for (auto &[_, c]: map) {
        pq.emplace(c);
    }

    int result = 0;
    while (pq.size() > k) {
        result += pq.top();
        pq.pop();
    }
    return result;
}
```

[2279. 装满石头的背包的最大数量](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-bags-with-full-capacity-of-rocks/)

```
int maximumBags(vector<int> &capacity, vector<int> &rocks, int additionalRocks) {
    int result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < capacity.size(); i++) {
        capacity[i] -= rocks[i];
        if (!capacity[i]) {
            result++;
        }
    }
    sort(capacity.begin(), capacity.end());
    for (int i = 0; i < capacity.size() && additionalRocks > 0; i++) {
        if (capacity[i]) {
            if (additionalRocks >= capacity[i]) {
                additionalRocks -= capacity[i];
                result++;
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

```
int maxIceCream(vector<int> &costs, int coins) {
    sort(costs.begin(), costs.end());
    int result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < costs.size() && coins > 0; i++) {
        if (coins >= costs[i]) {
            coins -= costs[i];
            result++;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

int largestSumAfterKNegations(vector<int> &nums, int k) {
    sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());
    int count = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        if (nums[i] < 0) {
            count++;
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size() && count && k; i++) {
        nums[i] = -nums[i];
        count--;
        k--;
    }
    
    sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());
    if (k % 2 == 1) {
        nums[0] = -nums[0];
    }
    return accumulate(nums.begin(), nums.end(), 0);
}
```

[1481. 不同整数的最少数目](https://leetcode.cn/problems/least-number-of-unique-integers-after-k-removals/)

```
int findLeastNumOfUniqueInts(vector<int> &arr, int k) {
    unordered_map<int, int> map;
    for (const auto &num: arr) {
        map[num]++;
    }

    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<>> pq;
    for (auto &[_, c]: map) {
        pq.emplace(c);
    }

    while (k > 0) {
        if (k >= pq.top()) {
            k -= pq.top();
            pq.pop();
        } else {
            k = 0;
        }
    }
    return pq.size();
}
```

[1710. 卡车上的最大单元数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-units-on-a-truck/)

```
int maximumUnits(vector<vector<int>> &boxTypes, int truckSize) {
    priority_queue<pair<int, int>> pq;
    for (const auto &type: boxTypes) {
        pq.emplace(type[1], type[0]);
    }

    int result = 0;
    while (truckSize && !pq.empty()) {
        const auto [capacity, amount] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        if (amount <= truckSize) {
            truckSize -= amount;
            result += amount * capacity;
        } else {
            result += truckSize * capacity;
            truckSize = 0;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

long long maxSum(vector<vector<int>> &grid, vector<int> &limits, int k) {
    priority_queue<pair<int, int>> pq;
    for (int i = 0; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < grid[i].size(); j++) {
            pq.emplace(grid[i][j], i);
        }
    }
    long long result = 0;
    while (!pq.empty() && k) {
        const auto [value, row] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        if (limits[row] != 0) {
            result += value;
            limits[row]--;
            k--;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

vector<int> maxSubsequence(vector<int> &nums, int k) {
    multimap<int, int, greater<>> map;
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        map.emplace(nums[i], i);
    }

    vector<pair<int, int>> sub;
    int i = 0;
    for (const auto &[num, index]: map) {
        if (i < k) {
            sub.emplace_back(index, num);
        } else {
            break;
        }
        i++;
    }

    sort(sub.begin(), sub.end());

    vector<int> result(k);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
        result[i] = sub[i].second;
    }
    return result;
}

    for (const auto &c: s) {
        map[c]++;

    for (const auto &[_, c]: map) {
        counts.emplace_back(c);

    int result = 0;
    for (int i = 1; i < counts.size(); i++) {
        if (counts[i] > counts[i - 1] - 1) {

            counts[i] = counts[i - 1] - 1;
        }

}

[1262. 可被三整除的最大和](https://leetcode.cn/problems/greatest-sum-divisible-by-three/)

```
int maxSumDivThree(vector<int> &nums) {
    int sum = accumulate(nums.begin(), nums.end(), 0);
    if (sum % 3 == 0) {
        return sum;
    } else {
        vector<vector<int>> array(3);
        for (const auto &num: nums) {
            array[num % 3].emplace_back(num);
        }
        sort(array[1].begin(), array[1].end());
        sort(array[2].begin(), array[2].end());
        if (sum % 3 == 2) {
            int result = INT_MIN;
            if (array[1].size() > 1) {
                result = max(result, sum - array[1][0] - array[1][1]);
            }
            if (!array[2].empty()) {
                result = max(result, sum - array[2][0]);
            }
            return result;
        } else {
            int result = INT_MIN;
            if (!array[1].empty()) {
                result = max(result, sum - array[1][0]);
            }
            if (array[2].size() > 1) {
                result = max(result, sum - array[2][0] - array[2][1]);
            }
            return result;
        }
    }
}
```

```
int bagOfTokensScore(vector<int> &tokens, int power) {
    sort(tokens.begin(), tokens.end());
    int i = 0;
    int j = tokens.size() - 1;
    int result = 0;
    while (i < j) {
        if (power >= tokens[i]) {
            power -= tokens[i];
            result++;
            i++;
        } else {
            if (result == 0 || i == j) {
                break;
            }
            power += tokens[j];
            result--;
            j--;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

bool checkIfCanBreak(string s1, string s2) {
    sort(s1.begin(), s1.end());
    sort(s2.begin(), s2.end());
    int count1 = 0;
    int count2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < s1.size(); ++i) {
        if (s1[i] == s2[i]) {
            count1++;
            count2++;
        } else if (s1[i] > s2[i]) {
            count1++;
        } else {
            count2++;
        }
    }
    return count1 == s1.size() || count2 == s2.size();
}

vector<int> advantageCount(vector<int> &nums1, vector<int> &nums2) {
    sort(nums1.begin(), nums1.end());
    vector<int> result;
    for (const auto &num: nums2) {
        auto upper = upper_bound(nums1.begin(), nums1.end(), num);
        if (upper != nums1.end()) {
            result.emplace_back(*upper);
            nums1.erase(upper);
        } else {
            result.emplace_back(nums1.front());
            nums1.erase(nums1.begin());
        }
    }
    return result;
}

[826. 安排工作以达到最大收益](https://leetcode.cn/problems/most-profit-assigning-work/)

```
int maxProfitAssignment(vector<int> &difficulty, vector<int> &profit, vector<int> &worker) {
    set<pair<int, int>> set;
    for (int i = 0; i < difficulty.size(); i++) {
        set.insert({difficulty[i], profit[i]});
    }
    int result = 0;
    for (const auto &w: worker) {
        pair<int, int> work(-1, -1);
        for (const auto &[d, p]: set) {
            if (w >= d) {
                if (work.second < p) {
                    work = {d, p};
                }
            } else {
                break;
            }
        }
        if (work.first != -1) {
            result += work.second;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

int minimumOperations(vector<vector<int>> &grid) {

    for (int j = 0; j < grid.front().size(); j++) {
        for (int i = 1; i < grid.size(); i++) {
            if (grid[i][j] <= grid[i - 1][j]) {
                result += grid[i - 1][j] + 1 - grid[i][j];
                grid[i][j] = grid[i - 1][j] + 1;
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size() - 3; i++) {
        if (!nums[i]) {
            nums[i] = 1;
            nums[i + 1] = nums[i + 1] ? 0 : 1;
            nums[i + 2] = nums[i + 2] ? 0 : 1;
            result++;
        }
    }
    if (nums[nums.size() - 3] + nums[nums.size() - 2] + nums[nums.size() - 1] == 3) {
        return result;
    } else if (nums[nums.size() - 3] + nums[nums.size() - 2] + nums[nums.size() - 1] == 0) {
        return result + 1;
    } else {

    }
}

bool canPlaceFlowers(vector<int> &flowerbed, int n) {
    if (flowerbed.size() == 1) {
        return flowerbed.front() ? n <= 0 : n - 1 <= 0;
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < flowerbed.size(); i++) {
        if (!flowerbed[i]) {
            if (i == 0) {
                if (!flowerbed[i + 1]) {
                    n--;
                    flowerbed[i] = 1;
                }
            } else if (i == flowerbed.size() - 1) {
                if (!flowerbed[i - 1]) {
                    n--;
                    flowerbed[i] = 1;
                }
            } else {
                if (!flowerbed[i - 1] && !flowerbed[i + 1]) {
                    n--;
                    flowerbed[i] = 1;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return n <= 0;
}

[2957. 消除相邻近似相等字符](https://leetcode.cn/problems/remove-adjacent-almost-equal-characters/)

```
int removeAlmostEqualCharacters(string word) {
    if (word.size() <= 1) {
        return 0;
    } else if (word.size() == 2) {
        return abs(word.front() - word.back()) <= 1;
    } else {
        int result = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i < word.size() - 1; i++) {
            if (abs(word[i] - word[i - 1]) <= 1) {
                for (char c = 'a'; c <= 'z'; c++) {
                    if (abs(c - word[i - 1]) > 1 && abs(c - word[i + 1]) > 1) {
                        word[i] = c;
                        break;
                    }
                }
                result++;
            }
        }
        if (abs(word[word.size() - 1] - word[word.size() - 2]) <= 1) {
            result++;
        }
        return result;
    }
}

[3576. 数组元素相等转换](https://leetcode.cn/problems/transform-array-to-all-equal-elements/)

```
bool canMakeEqual(vector<int> &nums, int k) {
    const auto &check = [&](bool positive) {
        int num = positive ? 1 : -1;
        int count = 0;
        int i = 0;
        while (i < nums.size()) {
            if (nums[i] == num) {
                int j = i + 1;
                while (j < nums.size() && nums[j] != num) {
                    j++;
                }
                if (j == nums.size()) {
                    return false;
                } else {
                    count += j - i;
                }
                if (count > k) {
                    return false;
                }
                i = j + 1;
            } else {
                i++;
            }
        }
        return true;
    };
    return check(true) || check(false);
}
```

[1144. 递减元素使数组呈锯齿状](https://leetcode.cn/problems/decrease-elements-to-make-array-zigzag/)

```
int movesToMakeZigzag(vector<int> &nums) {
    int even = 0;
    int odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
        int left = i == 0 ? INT_MAX : nums[i - 1];
        int right = i == nums.size() - 1 ? INT_MAX : nums[i + 1];
        if (i % 2) {
            odd += max(nums[i] - min(left, right) + 1, 0);
        } else {
            even += max(nums[i] - min(left, right) + 1, 0);
        }
    }
    return min(even, odd);
}

int minimumBuckets(string hamsters) {

    int result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < hamsters.size(); i++) {

                if (hamsters[i + 1] != 'H') {
                    result++;

                        hamsters[i - 1] = 'B';

                } else {

            } else {

                    if (hamsters[i + 1] != 'H') {
                        result++;
                        hamsters[i + 1] = 'B';
                    } else {
                        if (hamsters[i - 1] != 'H') {
                            result++;
                            hamsters[i - 1] = 'B';
                        } else {

                    }

}

int minOperations(int n) {
    int result = 1;
    while (n & (n - 1)) {
        int lowbit = n & -n;
        if (n & (lowbit << 1)) {
            n += lowbit;
        } else {
            n -= lowbit;
        }
        result++;
    }
    return result;
}

[2171. 拿出最少数目的魔法豆](https://leetcode.cn/problems/removing-minimum-number-of-magic-beans/)

```
long long minimumRemoval(vector<int> &beans) {
    sort(beans.begin(), beans.end());
    vector<long long> prefix(beans.size() + 1);
    for (int i = 1; i < prefix.size(); i++) {
        prefix[i] = prefix[i - 1] + beans[i - 1];
    }
    long long result = LONG_LONG_MAX;
    for (int i = 0; i < beans.size(); i++) {
        long long left = prefix[i];
        long long right = prefix[beans.size()] - prefix[i + 1] - (beans.size() - (i + 1)) * beans[i];
        result = min(result, left + right);
    }
    return result;
}
```

[3085. 成为 K 特殊字符串需要删除的最少字符数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-deletions-to-make-string-k-special/)

```
int minimumDeletions(string word, int k) {
    unordered_map<char, int> counts;
    for (const auto &c: word) {
        counts[c]++;
    }
    vector<int> frequencies;
    for (const auto &[_, count]: counts) {
        frequencies.emplace_back(count);
    }
    int result = INT_MAX;
    for (int i = 0; i < frequencies.size(); i++) {
        int deleted = 0;
        for (int j = 0; j < frequencies.size(); j++) {
            if (frequencies[j] < frequencies[i]) {
                deleted += frequencies[j];
            } else if (frequencies[j] > frequencies[i] + k) {
                deleted += frequencies[j] - (frequencies[i] + k);
            }
        }
        result = min(result, deleted);
    }
    return result;
}
```

[2335. 装满杯子需要的最短总时长](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-amount-of-time-to-fill-cups/)

```
int fillCups(vector<int> &amount) {
    priority_queue<int> pq;
    for (const auto &a: amount) {
        if (a > 0) {
            pq.emplace(a);
        }
    }
    int result = 0;
    while (!pq.empty()) {
        if (pq.size() > 1) {
            int a = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            int b = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            a--;
            if (a > 0) {
                pq.emplace(a);
            }
            b--;
            if (b > 0) {
                pq.emplace(b);
            }
            result++;
        } else {
            result += pq.top();
            break;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

[3659. 数组元素分组](https://leetcode.cn/problems/partition-array-into-k-distinct-groups/)

```
bool partitionArray(vector<int> &nums, int k) {
    unordered_map<int, int> counts;
    for (const auto &num: nums) {
        counts[num]++;
    }
    priority_queue<pair<int, int>> pq;
    for (const auto &[num, count]: counts) {
        pq.emplace(count, num);
    }
    int result = 0;
    while (pq.size() >= k) {
        vector<pair<int, int>> pairs;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            auto [count, num] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            count--;
            pairs.emplace_back(count, num);
        }
        for (const auto [count, num]: pairs) {
            if (count > 0) {
                pq.emplace(count, num);
            }
        }
        result++;
    }
    return pq.empty();
}
```

```
string strWithout3a3b(int a, int b) {
    if (b == 0) {
        return string(a, 'a');
    }
    if (a == 0) {
        return string(b, 'b');
    }
    if (a == b) {
        return "ab" + strWithout3a3b(a - 1, b - 1);
    }
    return a > b ? "aab" + strWithout3a3b(a - 2, b - 1) : "bba" + strWithout3a3b(a - 1, b - 2);
}

[767. 重构字符串](https://leetcode.cn/problems/reorganize-string/)

```
string reorganizeString(string s) {
    unordered_map<char, int> counts;
    for (char c: s) {
        counts[c]++;
    }
    priority_queue<pair<int, char>> pq;
    for (auto &[character, count]: counts) {
        pq.emplace(count, character);
    }

    string result;
    while (pq.size() > 1) {
        auto [count1, character1] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        auto [count2, character2] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        result += character1;
        result += character2;
        if (--count1 > 0) {
            pq.emplace(count1, character1);
        }
        if (--count2 > 0) {
            pq.emplace(count2, character2);
        }
    }
    return pq.empty() ? result : pq.top().first > 1 ? "" : result + pq.top().second;
}

[1054. 距离相等的条形码](https://leetcode.cn/problems/distant-barcodes/)

```
vector<int> rearrangeBarcodes(vector<int> &barcodes) {
    unordered_map<int, int> counts;
    for (const auto &barcode: barcodes) {
        counts[barcode]++;
    }
    priority_queue<pair<int, int>> pq;
    for (auto &[character, count]: counts) {
        pq.emplace(count, character);
    }

    vector<int> result;
    while (pq.size() > 1) {
        auto [count1, barcode1] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        auto [count2, barcode2] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        result.emplace_back(barcode1);
        result.emplace_back(barcode2);
        if (--count1 > 0) {
            pq.emplace(count1, barcode1);
        }
        if (--count2 > 0) {
            pq.emplace(count2, barcode2);
        }
    }
    if (pq.empty()) {
        return result;
    }
    if (pq.top().first > 1) {
        return {};
    } else {
        result.emplace_back(pq.top().second);
        return result;
    }
}
```

[LCP 30. 魔塔游戏](https://leetcode.cn/problems/p0NxJO/)

```
int magicTower(vector<int> &nums) {
    if (accumulate(nums.begin(), nums.end(), 0LL) < 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    int result = 0;
    long long health = 1;
    priority_queue<long long, vector<long long>, greater<long long>> pq;
    for (const auto &num: nums) {
        if (num < 0) {
            pq.emplace(num);
        }
        health += num;
        if (health <= 0) {
            health -= pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            result++;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

### 区间贪心

#### 不相交区间

- 核心思想：选择**结束最早**的区间
- 对所有区间的**右端点**进行排序
- 枚举每个区间的左端点，判断是否大于前一个区间的右端点，如果是则不相交区间的数量加一，如果不是则跳过

[435. 无重叠区间](https://leetcode.cn/problems/non-overlapping-intervals/)

```
int eraseOverlapIntervals(vector<vector<int>> &intervals) {
    sort(intervals.begin(), intervals.end(), [](const auto &a, const auto &b) { return a.back() < b.back(); });
    int result = 0;
    int right = INT_MIN;
    for (const auto &interval: intervals) {
        if (interval.front() >= right) {
            result++;
            right = interval.back();
        }
    }
    return intervals.size() - result;
}
```

int findLongestChain(vector<vector<int>> &pairs) {
    sort(pairs.begin(), pairs.end(), [](const auto &a, const auto &b) { return a.back() < b.back(); });
    int result = 0;
    int right = INT_MIN;
    for (const auto &pair: pairs) {
        if (pair.front() > right) {
            result++;
            right = pair.back();
        }
    }
    return result;
}

#### 区间分组

- 核心思想：选择**结束最早**的区间
- 对所有区间的**左端点**进行排序
- 用最小堆记录每个分组的最右端点
- 堆的大小即为分组数量

[2406. 将区间分为最少组数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/divide-intervals-into-minimum-number-of-groups/)

```
int minGroups(vector<vector<int>> &intervals) {
    sort(intervals.begin(), intervals.end());
    priority_queue<int, vector<int>, greater<>> pq;
    for (const auto &interval: intervals) {
        if (!pq.empty() && pq.top() < interval.front()) {
            pq.pop();
        }
        pq.emplace(interval.back());
    }
    return pq.size();
}
```

#### 区间选点

- 本质上是求不相交区间的数量
- 对所有区间的**右端点**进行排序
- 枚举每个区间的左端点，判断是否大于前一个区间的右端点，如果是则不相交区间的数量加一，如果不是则跳过

[452. 用最少数量的箭引爆气球](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-number-of-arrows-to-burst-balloons/)

```
int findMinArrowShots(vector<vector<int>> &points) {
    sort(points.begin(), points.end(), [](const auto &a, const auto &b) { return a.back() < b.back(); });
    int result = 0;
    long long right = LONG_LONG_MIN;
    for (const auto &point: points) {
        if (point.front() > right) {
            result++;
            right = point.back();
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

#### 区间覆盖

- 核心思想：选择**延伸最远**的区间
- 对区间的左端点进行排序
- 枚举当前能扩展到的最远位置

[45. 跳跃游戏 II](https://leetcode.cn/problems/jump-game-ii/)

```
int jump(vector<int> &nums) {
    int result = 0;
    int current = 0;
    int next = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < nums.size() - 1; i++) {
        next = max(next, i + nums[i]);
        if (i == current) {
            result++;
            current = next;
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[1024. 视频拼接](https://leetcode.cn/problems/video-stitching/)

```
int videoStitching(vector<vector<int>> &clips, int time) {
    sort(clips.begin(), clips.end());
    if (clips.front().front() != 0) {
        return -1;
    }
    int result = 0;
    int index = 0;
    int current = 0;
    int next = 0;
    while (current < time) {
        while (index < clips.size() && clips[index].front() <= current) {
            next = max(next, clips[index].back());
            index++;
        }
        if (current == next) {
            return -1;
        }
        result++;
        current = next;
    }
    return result;
}
```

#### 合并区间

- 核心思想：合并扩大当前区间
- 对区间的**左端点**进行排序
- 如果有重叠区间，则进行合并
- 如果有不重叠区间，则结算当前段

[56. 合并区间](https://leetcode.cn/problems/merge-intervals/)

```
vector<vector<int>> merge(vector<vector<int>> &intervals) {
    sort(intervals.begin(), intervals.end());
    vector<vector<int>> result;
    int left = INT_MIN;
    int right = INT_MIN;
    for (const auto &interval: intervals) {
        if (interval.front() <= right) {
            left = min(left, interval.front());
            right = max(right, interval.back());
        } else {
            if (left != INT_MIN && right != INT_MIN) {
                result.push_back({left, right});
            }
            left = interval.front();
            right = interval.back();
        }
    }
    result.push_back({left, right});
    return result;
}
```

[57. 插入区间](https://leetcode.cn/problems/insert-interval/)

vector<vector<int>> insert(vector<vector<int>> &intervals, vector<int> &newInterval) {
    intervals.emplace_back(newInterval);
    const auto merge = [&](vector<vector<int>> intervals) {
        sort(intervals.begin(), intervals.end());
        vector<vector<int>> result;
        int left = INT_MIN;
        int right = INT_MIN;
        for (const auto &interval: intervals) {
            if (interval.front() <= right) {
                left = min(left, interval.front());
                right = max(right, interval.back());
            } else {
                if (left != INT_MIN && right != INT_MIN) {
                    result.push_back({left, right});
                }
                left = interval.front();
                right = interval.back();
            }
        }
        result.push_back({left, right});
        return result;
    };
    return merge(intervals);
}

[763. 划分字母区间](https://leetcode.cn/problems/partition-labels/)

```
vector<int> partitionLabels(string s) {
    unordered_map<char, int> counts;
    for (const auto &c: s) {
        counts[c]++;
    }

    const auto check = [&](string s) {
        unordered_map<char, int> characters;
        for (const auto &c: s) {
            characters[c]++;
        }
        for (const auto &[character, count]: characters) {
            if (count < counts[character]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
        return true;
    };

    vector<int> result;
    int i = 0;
    int j = 0;
    while (j < s.size()) {
        if (check(s.substr(i, j - i + 1))) {
            result.emplace_back(j - i + 1);
            i = j + 1;
        }
        j++;
    }
    result.emplace_back(j - i + 1);
    return result;
}
```

[3169. 无需开会的工作日](https://leetcode.cn/problems/count-days-without-meetings/)

int countDays(int days, vector<vector<int>> &meetings) {
    sort(meetings.begin(), meetings.end());
    int result = 0;
    int previous = 0;
    for (const auto &meeting: meetings) {
        if (meeting.front() > previous) {
            result += meeting.front() - (previous + 1);
        }
        previous = max(previous, meeting.back());
    }
    result += days - previous;
    return result;
}

[2580. 统计将重叠区间合并成组的方案数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/count-ways-to-group-overlapping-ranges/)

```
int countWays(vector<vector<int>> &ranges) {
    sort(ranges.begin(), ranges.end());
    const int MOD = 1e9 + 7;
    int result = 1;
    int previous = INT_MIN;
    for (const auto &range: ranges) {
        if (range.front() > previous) {
            result = result * 2 % MOD;
        }
        previous = max(previous, range.back());
    }
    return result;
}

int removeCoveredIntervals(vector<vector<int>> &intervals) {
    sort(intervals.begin(), intervals.end(), [](const auto &a, const auto &b) {
        return a.front() != b.front() ? a.front() < b.front() : a.back() > b.back();

            result++;

}

string maxValue(string n, int x) {

        for (int i = 0; i < n.size(); i++) {
            if (n[i] - '0' > x) {
                n.insert(i, to_string(x));
                inserted = true;
                break;

        }

    } else {
        for (int i = 0; i < n.size(); i++) {
            if (n[i] - '0' < x) {
                n.insert(i, to_string(x));

int maxDiff(int num) {
    if (num < 10) {
        return 8;
    }
    string s = to_string(num);
    int x1 = s[0];
    if (x1 == '9') {
        for (int i = 1; i < s.size(); i++) {
            if (s[i] != '9') {
                x1 = s[i];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    int x2 = s[0];
    if (x2 == '1') {
        for (int i = 1; i < s.size(); i++) {
            if (s[i] != '1' && s[i] != '0') {
                x2 = s[i];
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    int a = 0;
    int b = 0;
    for (auto &c: s) {
        if (c == x1) {
            a = a * 10 + 9;
        } else {
            a = a * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
        if (c == x2) {
            b = b * 10 + (x2 == s[0]);
        } else {
            b = b * 10 + (c - '0');
        }
    }
    return a - b;
}

[670. 最大交换](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-swap/)

```
int maximumSwap(int num) {
    vector<int> digits;
    int n = num;
    while (n) {
        digits.emplace_back(n % 10);
        n /= 10;
    }
    reverse(digits.begin(), digits.end());
    for (int i = 0; i < digits.size(); i++) {
        int maximum = i;
        for (int j = i + 1; j < digits.size(); j++) {
            if (digits[j] >= digits[maximum]) {
                maximum = j;
            }
        }
        if (maximum != i && digits[maximum] != digits[i]) {
            swap(digits[i], digits[maximum]);
            break;
        }
    }
    int result = 0;
    for (const auto &digit: digits) {
        result = result * 10 + digit;
    }
    return result;
}
```

        if (d <= k) {
            c = 'a';
            k -= d;
        } else {
            c -= k;
            k = 0;
            break;
        }
    }
    return s;
}

string smallestNumber(string pattern) {

    stack<char> stack;
    char current = '1';
    for (int i = 0; i < pattern.size(); i++) {
        if (pattern[i] == 'I') {

            while (!stack.empty()) {

[2182. 构造限制重复的字符串](https://leetcode.cn/problems/construct-string-with-repeat-limit/)

```
string repeatLimitedString(string s, int repeatLimit) {
    unordered_map<char, int> counts;
    for (char c: s) {
        counts[c]++;
    }
    priority_queue<pair<char, int>, vector<pair<char, int>>> pq;
    for (const auto &[character, count]: counts) {
        pq.emplace(character, count);
    }
    string result;
    while (pq.size() > 1) {
        auto [character1, count1] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        auto [character2, count2] = pq.top();
        pq.pop();
        if (result.empty() || result.back() != character1) {
            if (count1 > repeatLimit) {
                pq.emplace(character1, count1 - repeatLimit);
                result += string(repeatLimit, character1);
                if (--count2) {
                    pq.emplace(character2, count2);
                }
                result += character2;
            } else {
                result += string(count1, character1);
                if (count2 > repeatLimit) {
                    pq.emplace(character2, count2 - repeatLimit);
                    result += string(repeatLimit, character2);
                } else {
                    result += string(count2, character2);
                }
            }
        } else {
            if (--count2) {
                pq.emplace(character2, count2);
            }
            result += character2;
            if (count1 > repeatLimit) {
                pq.emplace(character1, count1 - repeatLimit);
                result += string(repeatLimit, character1);
            } else {
                result += string(count1, character1);
            }
        }
    }
    if (pq.empty() || !result.empty() && result.back() == pq.top().first) {
        return result;
    } else {
        return result + string(min(repeatLimit, pq.top().second), pq.top().first);
    }
}
```

[738. 单调递增的数字](https://leetcode.cn/problems/monotone-increasing-digits/)

```
int monotoneIncreasingDigits(int n) {
    string number = to_string(n);
    int index = 1;
    while (index < number.length() && number[index - 1] <= number[index]) {
        index++;
    }
    if (index < number.length()) {
        while (index > 0 && number[index - 1] > number[index]) {
            number[index - 1]--;
            index--;
        }
        index++;
        while (index < number.length()) {
            number[index] = '9';
            index++;
        }
    }
    return stoi(number);
}
```

[3170. 删除星号以后字典序最小的字符串](https://leetcode.cn/problems/lexicographically-minimum-string-after-removing-stars/)

```
string clearStars(string s) {
    vector<vector<int>> stacks(26);
    for (int i = 0; i < s.size(); i++) {
        if (s[i] != '*') {
            stacks[s[i] - 'a'].emplace_back(i);
        } else {
            for (auto &stack: stacks) {
                if (!stack.empty()) {
                    stack.pop_back();
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    vector<int> indices;
    for (const auto &stack: stacks) {
        indices.insert(indices.end(), stack.begin(), stack.end());
    }
    sort(indices.begin(), indices.end());
    string result;
    for (int i = 0; i < indices.size(); i++) {
        result += s[indices[i]];
    }
    return result;
}

[409. 最长回文串](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-palindrome/)

```
int longestPalindrome(string s) {
    unordered_map<char, int> counts;
    for (const auto &c: s) {
        counts[c]++;
    }
    int result = 0;
    bool odd = false;
    for (const auto &[character, count]: counts) {
        if (count % 2 == 1) {
            result += count - 1;
            odd = true;
        } else {
            result += count;
        }
    }
    return odd ? result + 1 : result;
}

```
string makeSmallestPalindrome(string s) {
    for (int i = 0; i < s.size() / 2; i++) {
        if (s[i] != s[s.size() - 1 - i]) {
            s[i] = s[s.size() - 1 - i] = min(s[i], s[s.size() - 1 - i]);
        }
    }
    return s;
}
```

[517. 最小回文排列 I](https://leetcode.cn/problems/smallest-palindromic-rearrangement-i/)

```
string smallestPalindrome(string s) {
    map<char, int> counts;
    for (const auto &c: s) {
        counts[c]++;
    }
    string left;
    string mid;
    for (const auto &[character, count]: counts) {
        if (count % 2 == 1) {
            mid = character;
        }
        left += string(count / 2, character);
    }
    string right(left.rbegin(), left.rend());
    return left + mid + right;
}
```

[680. 验证回文串 II](https://leetcode.cn/problems/valid-palindrome-ii/)

```
bool validPalindrome(string s) {
    const auto check = [&](int i, int j) {
        while (i < j) {
            if (s[i] != s[j]) {
                return false;
            }
            i++;
            j--;
        }
        return true;
    };
    for (int i = 0; i < s.size() / 2; i++) {
        if (s[i] != s[s.size() - 1 - i]) {
            return check(i, s.size() - 1 - i - 1) || check(i + 1, s.size() - 1 - i);
        }
    }
    return true;
}
```

bool canConstruct(string s, int k) {

    for (const auto &c: s) {
        counts[c]++;
    }
    int odd = 0;
    for (const auto &[characters, count]: counts) {

        }
    }

}

[2131. 连接两字母单词得到的最长回文串](https://leetcode.cn/problems/longest-palindrome-by-concatenating-two-letter-words/)

```
int longestPalindrome(vector<string> &words) {
    vector<vector<int>> counts(26, vector<int>(26));
    for (const auto &word: words) {
        counts[word[0] - 'a'][word[1] - 'a']++;
    }
    int result = 0;
    int odd = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        int c = counts[i][i];
        result += c - c % 2;
        odd += c % 2;
        for (int j = i + 1; j < 26; j++) {
            result += 2 * min(counts[i][j], counts[j][i]);
        }
    }
    return 2 * (result + (odd >= 1));
}
```

[2384. 最大回文数字](https://leetcode.cn/problems/largest-palindromic-number/)

```
string largestPalindromic(string num) {
    map<char, int, greater<>> counts;
    for (const auto &c: num) {
        counts[c]++;
    }
    if (counts.size() == 1) {
        return counts.begin()->first == '0' ? "0" : num;
    }
    string left;
    string mid;
    for (const auto &[character, count]: counts) {
        if (count % 2 == 1) {
            mid = max(mid, string(1, character));
        }
        if (!left.empty() || character != '0') {
            left += string(count / 2, character);
        }
    }
    string right(left.rbegin(), left.rend());
    return left + mid + right;
}
```

    sort(s.begin(), s.end());
    int num1 = 0;
    int num2 = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < s.size(); i += 2) {

[2244. 完成所有任务需要的最少轮数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-rounds-to-complete-all-tasks/)

```
int minimumRounds(vector<int> &tasks) {
    sort(tasks.begin(), tasks.end());
    int result = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < tasks.size()) {
        int j = i + 1;
        while (j < tasks.size() && tasks[j] == tasks[i]) {
            j++;
        }
        int count = j - i;
        while (count) {
            if (count == 1) {
                return -1;
            } else if (count == 2 || count == 3) {
                result += 1;
                count = 0;
            } else if (count == 4) {
                result += 2;
                count = 0;
            } else {
                result += 1;
                count -= 3;
            }
        }
        i = j;
    }
    return result;
}
```

[1567. 乘积为正数的最长子数组长度](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-length-of-subarray-with-positive-product/)

```
int getMaxLen(vector<int>& nums) {
    vector<vector<int>> dp(nums.size(), vector<int>(2));
    dp[0][0] = nums[0] > 0 ? 1 : 0;
    dp[0][1] = nums[0] < 0 ? 1 : 0;
    int result = dp[0][0];
    for (int i = 1; i < dp.size(); i++) {
        if (nums[i] > 0) {
            dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][0] + 1;
            dp[i][1] = dp[i - 1][1] > 0 ? dp[i - 1][1] + 1 : 0;
        } else if (nums[i] < 0) {
            dp[i][0] = dp[i - 1][1] > 0 ? dp[i - 1][1] + 1 : 0;
            dp[i][1] = dp[i - 1][0] + 1;
        } else {
            dp[i][0] = 0;
            dp[i][1] = 0;
        }
        result = max(result, dp[i][0]);
    }
    return result;
}
```

#### 均值不等式

[3081. 替换字符串中的问号使分数最小](https://leetcode.cn/problems/replace-question-marks-in-string-to-minimize-its-value/)

```
string minimizeStringValue(string s) {
    unordered_map<char, int> counts;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; i++) {
        counts['a' + i] = 0;
    }

    int question = 0;
    for (const auto &c: s) {
        if (c != '?') {
            counts[c]++;
        } else {
            question++;
        }
    }

    const auto compare = [](const auto &a, const auto &b) {
        return a.first != b.first ? a.first > b.first : a.second > b.second;
    };
    priority_queue<pair<int, char>, vector<pair<int, char>>, decltype(compare)> pq;
    for (const auto &[character, count]: counts) {
        pq.emplace(count, character);
    }
    vector<char> characters;
    for (const auto &c: s) {
        if (c == '?') {
            auto [count, character] = pq.top();
            pq.pop();
            characters.emplace_back(character);
            pq.emplace(count + 1, character);
        }
    }
    sort(characters.begin(), characters.end());
    int index = 0;
    for (auto &c: s) {
        if (c == '?') {
            c = characters[index++];
        }
    }
    return s;
}
```

int minOperations(vector<vector<int>> &grid, int x) {
    vector<int> nums;
    for (int i = 0; i < grid.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < grid[i].size(); j++) {
            if ((grid[i][j] - grid[0][0]) % x != 0) {
                return -1;
            }
            nums.emplace_back(grid[i][j]);
        }
    }
    sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());
    int result = 0;
    for (const auto &num: nums) {
        result += abs(num - nums[nums.size() / 2]) / x;
    }
    return result;
}

```
int minimumAddedCoins(vector<int> &coins, int target) {
    sort(coins.begin(), coins.end());
    int result = 0;
    int i = 0;
    int value = 1;
    while (value <= target) {
        if (i < coins.size() && coins[i] <= value) {
            value += coins[i];
            i++;
        } else {
            value *= 2;
            result++;
        }
    }
    return result;
}

            i++;
        } else {

}

#### 其他

[1414. 和为 K 的最少斐波那契数字数目](https://leetcode.cn/problems/find-the-minimum-number-of-fibonacci-numbers-whose-sum-is-k/)

```
int findMinFibonacciNumbers(int k) {
    vector<int> nums({1, 1});
    int a = 0;
    int b = 1;
    int c = 1;
    while (c <= k) {
        a = b;
        b = c;
        c = a + b;
        nums.emplace_back(c);
    }
    int result = 0;
    while (k) {
        int lower = lower_bound(nums.begin(), nums.end(), k) - nums.begin();
        if (nums[lower] > k) {
            lower--;
        }
        result++;
        k -= nums[lower];
    }
    return result;
}
```

[3107. 使数组中位数等于 K 的最少操作数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-operations-to-make-median-of-array-equal-to-k/)

```
long long minOperationsToMakeMedianK(vector<int> &nums, int k) {
    sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());
    long long result = 0;
    int median = nums[nums.size() / 2];
    if (median != k) {
        if (median < k) {
            for (int i = nums.size() / 2; i < nums.size(); i++) {
                if (nums[i] < k) {
                    result += k - nums[i];
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int i = nums.size() / 2; i >= 0; i--) {
                if (nums[i] > k) {
                    result += nums[i] - k;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

int findNonMinOrMax(vector<int> &nums) {

        return -1;

        sort(nums.begin(), nums.end());
        int i = 0;
        while (i < nums.size() && nums[i] == nums.front()) {
            i++;

        int j = nums.size() - 1;

[3675. 转换字符串的最小操作次数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-operations-to-transform-string/)

```
int minOperations(string s) {
    unordered_set<char> set;
    for (const auto &c: s) {
        set.insert(c);
    }
    vector<char> characters;
    for (const auto &character: set) {
        characters.emplace_back(character);
    }
    sort(characters.begin(), characters.end());
    int result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < characters.size() - 1; i++) {
        if (characters[i] != 'a') {
            result += characters[i + 1] - characters[i];
        }
    }
    if (characters.back() == 'a') {
        return result;
    } else {
        result += 'z' - characters.back();
        return result + 1;
    }
}

[3638. 平衡装运的最大数量](https://leetcode.cn/problems/maximum-balanced-shipments/)

```
int maxBalancedShipments(vector<int> &weight) {
    int result = 0;
    int i = 0;
    while (i < weight.size()) {
        int j = i + 1;
        int maximum = weight[i];
        while (j < weight.size() && weight[j] >= maximum) {
            maximum = max(maximum, weight[j]);
            j++;
        }
        if (j == weight.size()) {
            break;
        }
        result++;
        i = j + 1;
    }
    return result;
}

int longestSubarray(vector<int> &nums) {

    int k = *max_element(nums.begin(), nums.end());
    int i = 0;
    while (i < nums.size()) {
        if (nums[i] == k) {
            int j = i + 1;
            while (j < nums.size() && nums[j] == nums[i]) {

[1992. 找到所有的农场组](https://leetcode.cn/problems/find-all-groups-of-farmland/)

```
vector<vector<int>> findFarmland(vector<vector<int>> &land) {
    vector<vector<int>> result;
    vector<vector<bool>> visited(land.size(), vector<bool>(land.front().size(), false));
    const function<void(int, int, vector<pair<int, int>> &)> dfs = [&](int i, int j,
                                                                       vector<pair<int, int>> &group) {
        visited[i][j] = true;
        group.emplace_back(i, j);
        static const vector<pair<int, int>> directions = {{0,  1},
                                                          {1,  0},
                                                          {0,  -1},
                                                          {-1, 0}};
        for (const auto &[dx, dy]: directions) {
            int x = i + dx;
            int y = j + dy;
            if (x >= 0 && x < land.size() && y >= 0 && y < land[x].size() && !visited[x][y] && land[x][y]) {
                dfs(x, y, group);
            }
        }
    };
    for (int i = 0; i < land.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < land[i].size(); j++) {
            if (!visited[i][j] && land[i][j]) {
                vector<pair<int, int>> group;
                dfs(i, j, group);
                int minx = group.front().first;
                int maxx = group.front().first;
                int miny = group.front().second;
                int maxy = group.front().second;
                for (const auto &[x, y]: group) {
                    if (x < minx) {
                        minx = x;
                    } else if (x > maxx) {
                        maxx = x;
                    }
                    if (y < miny) {
                        miny = y;
                    } else if (y > maxy) {
                        maxy = y;
                    }
                }
                result.push_back({minx, miny, maxx, maxy});
            }
        }
    }
    return result;
}
```

[1007. 行相等的最少多米诺旋转](https://leetcode.cn/problems/minimum-domino-rotations-for-equal-row/)

```
int minDominoRotations(vector<int> &tops, vector<int> &bottoms) {
    const auto rotate = [&](int domino) {
        int top = 0;
        int bottom = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < tops.size(); i++) {
            if (tops[i] != domino && bottoms[i] != domino) {
                return INT_MAX;
            } else if (tops[i] != domino) {
                top++;
            } else if (bottoms[i] != domino) {
                bottom++;
            }
        }
        return min(top, bottom);
    };
    int result = min(rotate(tops[0]), rotate(bottoms[0]));
    return result == INT_MAX ? -1 : result;
}
```

```
int countCollisions(string directions) {
    int result = 0;
    string stack;
    for (int i = 0; i < directions.size(); i++) {
        if (directions[i] == 'L') {
            if(!stack.empty()){
                while (!stack.empty()) {
                    if (stack.back() == 'R') {
                        result++;
                    }
                    stack.pop_back();
                }
                result++;
                stack.push_back('S');
            }
        } else if (directions[i] == 'R') {
            stack.push_back(directions[i]);
        } else {
            while (!stack.empty()) {
                if (stack.back() == 'R') {
                    result++;
                }
                stack.pop_back();
            }
            stack.push_back(directions[i]);
        }
    }
    return result;
}

[3471. 找出最大的几近缺失整数](https://leetcode.cn/problems/find-the-largest-almost-missing-integer/)

```
int largestInteger(vector<int> &nums, int k) {
    if (k == nums.size()) {
        return *max_element(nums.begin(), nums.end());
    } else if (k == 1) {
        unordered_map<int, int> counts;
        for (int i = 0; i < nums.size(); i++) {
            counts[nums[i]]++;
        }
        int result = -1;
        for (const auto &[num, count]: counts) {
            if (count == 1) {
                result = max(result, num);
            }
        }
        return result;
    } else {
        unordered_set<int> set;
        for (int i = 1; i < nums.size() - 1; i++) {
            set.insert(nums[i]);
        }

        if (nums.front() == nums.back()) {
            return -1;
        }

        if (set.contains(nums.front()) && set.contains(nums.back())) {
            return -1;
        } else if (set.contains(nums.front())) {
            return nums.back();
        } else if (set.contains(nums.back())) {
            return nums.front();
        } else {
            return max(nums.front(), nums.back());
        }
    }
}
```

```
int getLastMoment(int n, vector<int> &left, vector<int> &right) {
    if (left.empty() && right.empty()) {
        return 0;
    } else if (left.empty()) {
        return n - *min_element(right.begin(), right.end());
    } else if (right.empty()) {
        return *max_element(left.begin(), left.end());
    } else {
        int l = *max_element(left.begin(), left.end());
        int r = n - *min_element(right.begin(), right.end());
        return max(l, r);
    }
}

long long maxMatrixSum(vector<vector<int>> &matrix) {
    int minus = 0;
    int zero = 0;
    int minimum = INT_MAX;
    for (int i = 0; i < matrix.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < matrix[i].size(); j++) {
            if (matrix[i][j] < 0) {
                minus++;
            }
            if (matrix[i][j] != 0) {
                minimum = min(minimum, abs(matrix[i][j]));
            } else {
                zero++;
            }
        }
    }
    long long result = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < matrix.size(); i++) {
        for (int j = 0; j < matrix[i].size(); j++) {
            result += abs(matrix[i][j]);
        }
    }
    return minus % 2 == 0 || zero > 0 ? result : result - 2 * minimum;
}
```

```
bool btreeGameWinningMove(TreeNode *root, int n, int x) {
    int left = 0;
    int right = 0;
    const function<int(TreeNode *)> dfs = [&](TreeNode *root) {
        if (root) {
            int l = dfs(root->left);
            int r = dfs(root->right);
            if (root->val == x) {
                left = l;
                right = r;
            }
            return 1 + l + r;
        } else {
            return 0;
        }
    };
    dfs(root);
    return (n - left - right - 1) > n / 2 || left > n / 2 || right > n / 2;
}
